# chat_routes.py
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify
from sqlalchemy import text
from backend.database import engine as db
# from auth_middleware import token_required  # Apna token middleware import kar lena

chat_bp = Blueprint('chat_bp', __name__)

@chat_bp.route('/chat_history/<int:friend_id>', methods=['GET'])
# @token_required
def get_chat_history(friend_id):
    current_user_id = request.args.get('user_id') # Real app mein token se aayega
    
    with db.connect() as conn:
        query = text("""
            SELECT sender_id, receiver_id, message, sent_at 
            FROM chat_messages 
            WHERE (sender_id = :me AND receiver_id = :friend) 
               OR (sender_id = :friend AND receiver_id = :me)
            ORDER BY sent_at ASC
        """)
        result = conn.execute(query, {"me": current_user_id, "friend": friend_id}).fetchall()
        
        chat_history = []
        for row in result:
            chat_history.append({
                "sender_id": row[0],
                "receiver_id": row[1],
                "message": row[2],
                "sent_at": row[3]
            })
            
    return jsonify({"history": chat_history}), 200


@chat_bp.route('/get_friends/<int:user_id>', methods=['GET'])
def get_friends(user_id):
    with db.connect() as conn:
        # DISTINCT lagaya hai taaki agar dono ek dusre ko follow karte hain toh naam 2 baar na aaye
        query = text("""
            SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id, u.username, u.profile_image
            FROM users u
            JOIN followers f ON (f.follower_id = u.user_id OR f.following_id = u.user_id)
            WHERE (f.follower_id = :uid OR f.following_id = :uid)
              AND u.user_id != :uid
        """)
        result = conn.execute(query, {"uid": user_id}).fetchall()
        
        friends = []
        for row in result:
            # Agar database mein profile_image nahi hai, toh username ka pehla letter use karenge
            profile_image = row[2]
            avatar = profile_image if profile_image else row[1][0].upper()
            
            friends.append({
                "id": row[0],
                "username": row[1],
                "avatar": avatar,
                "has_image": bool(profile_image) # Frontend ko batane ke liye ki asli image hai ya text
            })
            
    return jsonify({"friends": friends}), 200

<file path="backend/chat_sockets.py">
# chat_sockets.py
from flask_socketio import join_room, emit
from sqlalchemy import text
from backend.database import engine as db# Tera database connection file

def register_chat_sockets(socketio):
    
    @socketio.on('join_chat')
    def handle_join(data):
        user_id = data.get('user_id')
        if user_id:
            room = f"user_{user_id}"
            join_room(room)
            print(f"User {user_id} joined room {room}")

    @socketio.on('send_message')
    def handle_send_message(data):
        sender_id = data.get('sender_id')
        receiver_id = data.get('receiver_id')
        message_text = data.get('message')

        # 1. Message ko MySQL database mein save karna
        with db.connect() as conn:
            query = text("""
                INSERT INTO chat_messages (sender_id, receiver_id, message) 
                VALUES (:sender_id, :receiver_id, :message)
            """)
            conn.execute(query, {"sender_id": sender_id, "receiver_id": receiver_id, "message": message_text})
            conn.commit()

        # 2. Live message receiver ke room mein bhej dena
        emit('receive_message', {
            'sender_id': sender_id,
            'receiver_id': receiver_id,
            'message': message_text
        }, room=f"user_{receiver_id}")
        
        print(f"Message sent from {sender_id} to {receiver_id}")

<file path="Frontend_react/src/components/Chat.jsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { io } from "socket.io-client";
import "../styles/Chat.css"; 

const SOCKET_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:5000";

const Chat = () => {
  const [socket, setSocket] = useState(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState("");
  const [friendsList, setFriendsList] = useState([]); // Real friends store honge
  const [activeFriend, setActiveFriend] = useState(null);
  
  const myUserId = 1; // Yahan baad mein localStorage se apni ID daal dena

  // 1. Database se Real Friends load karo
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(`${SOCKET_URL}/get_friends/${myUserId}`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
        if (data.friends && data.friends.length > 0) {
          setFriendsList(data.friends);
          setActiveFriend(data.friends[0]); // Default pehle dost ko select kar lo
        }
      })
      .catch((err) => console.error("Error fetching friends:", err));
  }, []);

  // 2. Socket Connection & Chat History
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeFriend) return; // Jab tak dost load na ho, socket mat chalao

    const newSocket = io(SOCKET_URL);
    setSocket(newSocket);

    newSocket.emit("join_chat", { user_id: myUserId });

    newSocket.on("receive_message", (data) => {
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, data]);
    });

    // Real history API call
    fetch(`${SOCKET_URL}/chat_history/${activeFriend.id}?user_id=${myUserId}`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
        setMessages(data.history || []);
      })
      .catch((err) => console.error("Error fetching history:", err));

    return () => newSocket.disconnect();
  }, [activeFriend]);

  const handleSendMessage = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newMessage.trim() || !socket) return;

    const msgData = {
      sender_id: myUserId,
      receiver_id: activeFriend.id,
      message: newMessage,
    };

    socket.emit("send_message", msgData);
    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, { ...msgData, sent_at: new Date() }]);
    setNewMessage("");
  };

  return (
    <div className="nexus-chat-layout">
      {/* --- Left Sidebar --- */}
      <div className="nexus-sidebar">
        <div className="sidebar-header">
          <input type="text" placeholder="Search real friends..." className="search-bar" />
        </div>
        <div className="friends-list">
          {friendsList.length === 0 ? (
            <p style={{ padding: '20px', color: '#888' }}>No friends found in database.</p>
          ) : (
            friendsList.map((friend) => (
              <div
                key={friend.id}
                className={`friend-tile ${activeFriend?.id === friend.id ? "active" : ""}`}
                onClick={() => setActiveFriend(friend)}
              >
                <div className="avatar">
                {friend.has_image ? (
                    <img src={friend.avatar} alt={friend.username} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', borderRadius: '50%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
                ) : (
                    friend.avatar
                )}
                </div>
                <div className="friend-details">
                  <h4>{friend.username}</h4>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* --- Right Main Chat Area --- */}
      {activeFriend ? (
        <div className="nexus-chat-area">
          <div className="chat-header">
            <div className="header-info">
              <div className="avatar">{activeFriend.avatar}</div>
              <div>
                <h3>{activeFriend.username}</h3>
                <span className="status">Online</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* Call aur Video Call wale buttons hata diye, bas Option menu rakha hai */}
            <div className="header-actions">
              <button className="icon-btn">⋮</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="chat-messages-container">
            {messages.length === 0 ? (
              <p style={{ textAlign: "center", color: "#666", marginTop: "20px" }}>Start chatting with {activeFriend.username}...</p>
            ) : (
              messages.map((msg, idx) => {
                const isMe = msg.sender_id === myUserId;
                return (
                  <div key={idx} className={`message-wrapper ${isMe ? "me" : "friend"}`}>
                    {!isMe && <div className="small-avatar">{activeFriend.avatar}</div>}
                    <div className={`message-bubble ${isMe ? "my-bubble" : "friend-bubble"}`}>
                      {msg.message}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>

          <form className="chat-input-container" onSubmit={handleSendMessage}>
            <button type="button" className="icon-btn attachment-btn">📎</button>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Type your message and press enter..."
              value={newMessage}
              onChange={(e) => setNewMessage(e.target.value)}
            />
            <button type="submit" className="send-btn" disabled={!newMessage.trim()}>Send 🚀</button>
          </form>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="nexus-chat-area" style={{ justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <h3>Select a friend to start chatting</h3>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Chat;
</file>

<file path="backend/middleware/auth_middleware.py">
from functools import wraps

from flask import request, jsonify, g
import jwt

from backend.config import JWT_SECRET_KEY


def token_required(f):

    @wraps(f)
    def decorated(*args, **kwargs):

        auth_header = request.headers.get("Authorization")

        if not auth_header:
            return jsonify({
                "error": "Authorization token is required"
            }), 401

        if not auth_header.startswith("Bearer "):
            return jsonify({
                "error": "Invalid authorization format"
            }), 401

        token = auth_header.split(" ")[1]

        try:

            payload = jwt.decode(
                token,
                JWT_SECRET_KEY,
                algorithms=["HS256"]
            )

            g.user_id = payload["user_id"]
            g.user_email = payload["email"]

        except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:

            return jsonify({
                "error": "Token has expired"
            }), 401

        except jwt.InvalidTokenError:

            return jsonify({
                "error": "Invalid token"
            }), 401

        return f(*args, **kwargs)

    return decorated

from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request, g
from sqlalchemy import text
from backend.database import engine
from backend.middleware.auth_middleware import token_required

collections_bp = Blueprint("collections", __name__)

# 1. Create a new collection
@collections_bp.route("/collections", methods=["POST"])
@token_required
def create_collection():
    user_id = g.user_id
    data = request.get_json()
    title = data.get("title", "").strip()
    description = data.get("description", "").strip()

    if not title:
        return jsonify({"error": "Collection title is required"}), 400

    with engine.begin() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(
            text("""
                INSERT INTO collections (user_id, title, description)
                VALUES (:user_id, :title, :description)
            """),
            {"user_id": user_id, "title": title, "description": description}
        )
        collection_id = result.lastrowid

    return jsonify({"message": "Collection created successfully", "collection_id": collection_id}), 201

# 2. Get user's collections
@collections_bp.route("/user/<int:user_id>/collections", methods=["GET"])
def get_user_collections(user_id):
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        collections = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT c.collection_id, c.title, c.description, c.created_at,
                       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_movies cm WHERE cm.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS movie_count
                FROM collections c
                WHERE c.user_id = :user_id
                ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
            """),
            {"user_id": user_id}
        ).mappings().all()

    return jsonify([dict(c) for c in collections]), 200

# 3. Add movie to collection
# Movie ko collection mein add karne ka route
@collections_bp.route("/collections/<int:collection_id>/movies", methods=["POST"])
@token_required
def add_movie_to_collection(collection_id):
    data = request.get_json()
    movie_id = data.get("movie_id")

    if not movie_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Movie ID is required"}), 400

    with engine.begin() as conn:
        # Check agar movie pehle se us collection mein hai
        exists = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT id FROM collection_movies WHERE collection_id = :cid AND movie_id = :mid"),
            {"cid": collection_id, "mid": movie_id}
        ).fetchone()

        if exists:
            return jsonify({"message": "Movie is already in this collection"}), 400

        conn.execute(
            text("INSERT INTO collection_movies (collection_id, movie_id) VALUES (:cid, :mid)"),
            {"cid": collection_id, "mid": movie_id}
        )

    return jsonify({"message": "Movie added to collection successfully"}), 200


@collections_bp.route("/collections/<int:collection_id>", methods=["GET"])
def get_collection_details(collection_id):
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        # Collection ki info nikalo
        col = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT collection_id, title, description, created_at FROM collections WHERE collection_id = :cid"),
            {"cid": collection_id}
        ).mappings().first()

        if not col:
            return jsonify({"error": "Collection not found"}), 404

        # Us collection ke andar jitni movies hain unki details nikalo
        movies = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT m.movie_id, m.title, m.release_year, m.runtime_minutes, m.poster_url, m.avg_rating
                FROM collection_movies cm
                JOIN movies m ON cm.movie_id = m.movie_id
                WHERE cm.collection_id = :cid
            """),
            {"cid": collection_id}
        ).mappings().all()

    return jsonify({
        "collection": dict(col),
        "movies": [dict(m) for m in movies]
    }), 200

<file path="backend/routes/rating.py">
from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request, g
from sqlalchemy import text

from backend.database import engine
from backend.middleware.auth_middleware import token_required


rating_bp = Blueprint("rating", __name__)


# Add / Update rating
@rating_bp.route("/ratings/<int:movie_id>", methods=["POST"])
@token_required
def rate_movie(movie_id):

    user_id = g.user_id

    data = request.get_json()

    if not data or "rating" not in data:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Rating is required"
        }), 400

    try:
        rating = float(data["rating"])
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Rating must be a number"
        }), 400

    # Validate rating
    if rating < 1 or rating > 5:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Rating must be between 1 and 5"
        }), 400

    if rating * 2 != int(rating * 2):
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Rating must be in 0.5 increments"
        }), 400

    # Check movie exists
    with engine.connect() as conn:

        movie = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT movie_id, title
                FROM movies
                WHERE movie_id = :movie_id
            """),
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).first()

    if movie is None:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Movie not found"
        }), 404

    # Check if user already rated this movie
    with engine.connect() as conn:

        existing = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT rating_id
                FROM ratings
                WHERE user_id = :user_id
                AND movie_id = :movie_id
            """),
            {
                "user_id": user_id,
                "movie_id": movie_id
            }
        ).first()

    # Update existing rating
    if existing:

        with engine.begin() as conn:

            conn.execute(
                text("""
                    UPDATE ratings
                    SET rating = :rating,
                        rated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE user_id = :user_id
                    AND movie_id = :movie_id
                """),
                {
                    "rating": rating,
                    "user_id": user_id,
                    "movie_id": movie_id
                }
            )

        return jsonify({
            "message": "Rating updated successfully",
            "movie_id": movie_id,
            "rating": rating
        }), 200

    # Insert new rating
    with engine.begin() as conn:

        conn.execute(
            text("""
                INSERT INTO ratings (user_id, movie_id, rating)
                VALUES (:user_id, :movie_id, :rating)
            """),
            {
                "user_id": user_id,
                "movie_id": movie_id,
                "rating": rating
            }
        )

    return jsonify({
        "message": "Rating added successfully",
        "movie_id": movie_id,
        "rating": rating
    }), 201

@rating_bp.route("/ratings/<int:movie_id>", methods=["GET"])
@token_required
def get_movie_ratings(movie_id):

    with engine.connect() as conn:

        movie = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT movie_id, title, avg_rating
                FROM movies
                WHERE movie_id = :movie_id
            """),
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).first()

        if movie is None:
            return jsonify({
                "error": "Movie not found"
            }), 404

        ratings = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT
                    r.rating,
                    r.rated_at
                FROM ratings r
                WHERE r.movie_id = :movie_id
                ORDER BY r.rated_at DESC
            """),
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).mappings().all()

    rating_list = [dict(rating) for rating in ratings]

    return jsonify({
        "movie_id": movie.movie_id,
        "title": movie.title,
        "average_rating": movie.avg_rating,
        "total_ratings": len(rating_list),
        "ratings": rating_list
    }), 200


# Delete user's rating
@rating_bp.route("/ratings/<int:movie_id>", methods=["DELETE"])
@token_required
def delete_rating(movie_id):

    user_id = g.user_id

    with engine.begin() as conn:

        result = conn.execute(
            text("""
                DELETE FROM ratings
                WHERE user_id = :user_id
                AND movie_id = :movie_id
            """),
            {
                "user_id": user_id,
                "movie_id": movie_id
            }
        )

    if result.rowcount == 0:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Rating not found"
        }), 404

    return jsonify({
        "message": "Rating deleted successfully",
        "movie_id": movie_id
    }), 200

<file path="backend/scripts/import_table.py">
import os
import sys
import pandas as pd

# Backend path
backend_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, backend_path)

from database import engine

if len(sys.argv) != 2:
    print("Usage: python scripts/import_table.py <table_name>")
    sys.exit()

table_name = sys.argv[1]

csv_path = os.path.abspath(
    os.path.join(
        backend_path,
        "..",
        "dataset",
        "processed",
        f"{table_name}.csv"
    )
)

if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    print(f"CSV not found: {csv_path}")
    sys.exit()

print("=" * 60)
print(f"Importing : {table_name}")
print(f"Reading   : {csv_path}")

df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

print(f"Rows      : {len(df):,}")

df.to_sql(
    table_name,
    engine,
    if_exists="append",
    index=False,
    chunksize=1000,
    method="multi"
)

print("✅ Import Completed")

<file path="backend/sql/create_table.sql">
CREATE DATABASE movieverse_db;
SHOW DATABASES;
USE movieverse_db;

CREATE TABLE movies (
    movie_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    release_year SMALLINT,
    tagline TEXT,
    overview LONGTEXT,
    runtime_minutes SMALLINT,
    avg_rating DECIMAL(3,2),
    poster_url TEXT
);


CREATE TABLE genres (
    genre_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    genre_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE movie_genres (
    movie_id BIGINT,
    genre_id INT,

    PRIMARY KEY (movie_id, genre_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (genre_id)
        REFERENCES genres(genre_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE languages (
    language_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    language_name VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE movie_languages (
    movie_id BIGINT,
    language_id INT,

    PRIMARY KEY (movie_id, language_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (language_id)
        REFERENCES languages(language_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);


SHOW TABLES;

CREATE TABLE countries (
    country_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    country_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE movie_countries (
    movie_id BIGINT,
    country_id INT,

    PRIMARY KEY (movie_id, country_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (country_id)
        REFERENCES countries(country_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE themes (
    theme_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    theme_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE movie_themes (
    movie_id BIGINT,
    theme_id INT,

    PRIMARY KEY (movie_id, theme_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (theme_id)
        REFERENCES themes(theme_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE actors (
    actor_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    actor_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);


CREATE TABLE movie_actors (
    movie_id BIGINT,
    actor_id INT,
    role VARCHAR(255),

    PRIMARY KEY (movie_id, actor_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (actor_id)
        REFERENCES actors(actor_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE directors (
    director_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    director_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE movie_directors (
    movie_id BIGINT,
    director_id INT,

    PRIMARY KEY (movie_id, director_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (director_id)
        REFERENCES directors(director_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE producers (
    producer_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    producer_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE movie_producers (
    movie_id BIGINT,
    producer_id INT,

    PRIMARY KEY (movie_id, producer_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (producer_id)
        REFERENCES producers(producer_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE users (
    user_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    profile_image TEXT,
    bio TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE ratings (
    rating_id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    movie_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    rating DECIMAL(2,1) NOT NULL,
    rated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    UNIQUE KEY unique_rating (user_id, movie_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE reviews (
    review_id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    movie_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    review_text TEXT,
    likes INT DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE watchlist (
    user_id INT,
    movie_id BIGINT,
    added_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, movie_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE favorites (
    user_id INT,
    movie_id BIGINT,
    added_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, movie_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    FOREIGN KEY (movie_id)
        REFERENCES movies(movie_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE search_history (
    history_id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT,
    search_query VARCHAR(255),
    searched_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX idx_movies_title ON movies(title);

CREATE INDEX idx_movies_year ON movies(release_year);

CREATE INDEX idx_movies_rating ON movies(avg_rating);

CREATE INDEX idx_movie_genres_movie ON movie_genres(movie_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_movie_actors_movie ON movie_actors(movie_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_movie_directors_movie ON movie_directors(movie_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_ratings_movie ON ratings(movie_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_reviews_movie ON reviews(movie_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_watchlist_user ON watchlist(user_id);


SHOW TABLES;
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/README.md">
# React + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the Oxlint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend using TypeScript with type-aware lint rules enabled. Check out the [TS template](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/main/packages/create-vite/template-react-ts) for information on how to integrate TypeScript and Oxlint's TypeScript related rules in your project.
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/App.css">
* {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
}

body {
  background-color: #050507;
  color: #ffffff;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

a {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: #8B3DFF;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

a:hover {
  color: #9B4DFF;
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/components/PosterAnimation.jsx">
import poster1 from "../assets/posters/poster1.jpg";
import poster2 from "../assets/posters/poster2.jpg";
import poster3 from "../assets/posters/poster3.webp";
import poster4 from "../assets/posters/poster4.webp";
import poster5 from "../assets/posters/poster5.webp";
import poster6 from "../assets/posters/poster6.webp";

import "../styles/login.css";
import "../styles/posterAnimation.css";

import React from "react";


const posters = [
  poster3,
  poster6,
  poster1,
  poster4,
  poster5,
  poster2,
];


function PosterColumn({ direction = "up" }) {

  // 4 complete sets
  const repeated = [
    ...posters,
    ...posters,
    ...posters,
    ...posters
  ];

  return (
    <div
      className={`poster-column ${
        direction === "up" ? "move-up" : "move-down"
      }`}
    >

      {repeated.map((poster, index) => (

        <img
          src={poster}
          alt="Movie poster"
          className="movie-poster"
          key={`${poster}-${index}`}
        />

      ))}

    </div>
  );
}


export default function PosterAnimation() {

  return (

    <div className="poster-area">

      {/* Moving poster columns */}

      <div className="poster-columns">

        <PosterColumn direction="up" />

        <PosterColumn direction="down" />

        <PosterColumn direction="up" />

        <PosterColumn direction="down" />

      </div>


      {/* Dark overlay */}

      <div className="poster-overlay"></div>


      {/* MovieVerse name */}

      <div className="movieverse-logo">
        MovieVerse
      </div>

    </div>

  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/pages/ExploreMovies.jsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation,useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import Navbar from "../components/Navbar";
import { getSurpriseMovie } from "../services/homeService";
import "../styles/explore.css";
import CinematicLoader from "../components/CinematicLoader";

export default function ExploreMovies() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const initialGenre = location.state?.genre || "All";

  const [movies, setMovies] = useState([]);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // --- Advanced Filters State ---
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState("Newest");
  const [selectedGenre, setSelectedGenre] = useState(initialGenre);
  const [selectedLang, setSelectedLang] = useState("All");
  const [selectedDuration, setSelectedDuration] = useState("All");
  const [selectedDecade, setSelectedDecade] = useState("All");

  const observer = useRef();
  const lastMovieElementRef = useCallback(
    (node) => {
      if (loading) return <CinematicLoader />;
      if (observer.current) observer.current.disconnect();
      observer.current = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting && hasMore) {
          setPage((prevPage) => prevPage + 1);
        }
      });
      if (node) observer.current.observe(node);
    },
    [loading, hasMore]
  );

  // Naya fetch jisme saare parameters hain
  const fetchMovies = async (pageNum) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const url = `http://127.0.0.1:5000/explore/movies?page=${pageNum}&limit=20&genre=${selectedGenre}&sort_by=${sortBy}&lang=${selectedLang}&duration=${selectedDuration}&decade=${selectedDecade}`;
      
      const res = await fetch(url);
      const data = await res.json();
      
      // 🛡️ SECURITY CHECK: Agar API ne error bheja toh crash mat ho!
      if (!res.ok || !data.movies) {
        console.error("API Error:", data.error || "Movies not found");
        return; // Yahan se wapas laut jao, app crash nahi hoga
      }

      setMovies((prev) => (pageNum === 1 ? data.movies : [...prev, ...data.movies]));
      setHasMore(data.has_more);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Explore fetch error:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Jab bhi KOI BHI filter change ho, tabhi page 1 se reload karo
  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1);
    fetchMovies(1);
    // eslint-disable-next-line
  }, [selectedGenre, sortBy, selectedLang, selectedDuration, selectedDecade]);


  useEffect(() => {
    if (page > 1) fetchMovies(page);
    // eslint-disable-next-line
  }, [page]);

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSortBy("Newest");
    setSelectedGenre("All");
    setSelectedLang("All");
    setSelectedDuration("All");
    setSelectedDecade("All");
  };

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [isSurprising, setIsSurprising] = useState(false);
  const [surpriseMovie, setSurpriseMovie] = useState(null);

  const handleSurpriseMe = async () => {
    setIsSurprising(true);
    
    
    const data = await getSurpriseMovie();
    
    if (data && data.movie_id) {
      // 🔥 MAGIC YAHAN HAI: Right side ki saari movies hata kar sirf ye ek movie dikha do
      setMovies([data]); 
      setHasMore(false); // Infinite scroll band kar do taaki aur movies load na hon
    } else {
      alert("Oops! Couldn't find a surprise movie right now.");
    }
    
    setIsSurprising(false);
  };

  // Filter Options arrays
  const genresList = ["All", "Action", "Comedy", "Drama", "Horror", "Sci-Fi", "Romance", "Thriller", "Mystery"];
  const durationList = ["All", "Under 90m", "90-120m", "120m+"];
  
  return (
    <div className="explore-wrapper">
      <Navbar />

      <div className="explore-layout">
        {/* --- LEFT SIDEBAR (PREMIUM FILTERS) --- */}
        <aside className="explore-sidebar">
          <div className="filter-header">
            <h3>Filters <span>{movies.length > 0 ? "Active" : ""}</span></h3>
            <button onClick={clearFilters} className="clear-btn">✕ Clear</button>
          </div>

          <div className="filter-scroll-area">
            {/* SORTING */}
            <div className="filter-section">
              <label>SORT BY</label>
              <div className="custom-select-wrapper">
                <select value={sortBy} onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value)} className="filter-select">
                  <option value="Newest">Newest Releases</option>
                  <option value="Top Rated">Top Rated</option>
                  <option value="A-Z">Alphabetical (A-Z)</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* GENRES (Grid Style Badges) */}
            <div className="filter-section">
              <label>GENRE</label>
              <div className="genre-badges-grid">
                {genresList.map((g) => (
                  <button
                    key={g}
                    className={`filter-badge ${selectedGenre === g ? "active" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedGenre(g)}
                  >
                    {selectedGenre === g && <span className="active-dot"></span>}
                    {g}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* LANGUAGES (Select) */}
            <div className="filter-section">
              <label>LANGUAGE</label>
              <div className="custom-select-wrapper">
                <select value={selectedLang} onChange={(e) => setSelectedLang(e.target.value)} className="filter-select">
                  <option value="All">All Languages</option>
                  <option value="English">English</option>
                  <option value="Hindi">Hindi</option>
                  <option value="Japanese">Japanese</option>
                  <option value="Korean">Korean</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* DECADE (Select) */}
            <div className="filter-section">
              <label>DECADE</label>
              <div className="custom-select-wrapper">
                <select value={selectedDecade} onChange={(e) => setSelectedDecade(e.target.value)} className="filter-select">
                  <option value="All">All Time</option>
                  <option value="2020s">2020s</option>
                  <option value="2010s">2010s</option>
                  <option value="2000s">2000s</option>
                  <option value="Classic">Classics (Pre-2000)</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* DURATION (Pills) */}
            <div className="filter-section">
              <label>DURATION</label>
              <div className="duration-pills">
                {durationList.map(dur => (
                  <button 
                    key={dur} 
                    className={`dur-pill ${selectedDuration === dur ? "active" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedDuration(dur)}
                  >
                    {dur}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* 🔥 NAYA BADA SURPRISE ME BOX YAHAN AAYEGA 🔥 */}
            {/* 🔥 SIMPLE & SLEEK SURPRISE ME BUTTON 🔥 */}
            <div className="surprise-me-box-container">
              <button 
                className="btn-surprise-me-simple" 
                onClick={handleSurpriseMe} 
                disabled={isSurprising}
              >
                {isSurprising ? "Searching..." : "Surprise Me"}
              </button>

              
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>

        {/* --- RIGHT MAIN GRID --- */}
        <main className="explore-main">
          

          {/* Active Tags Bar */}
          <div className="active-tags-bar">
            {selectedGenre !== "All" && <span className="glow-tag">{selectedGenre}</span>}
            {selectedLang !== "All" && <span className="glow-tag">{selectedLang}</span>}
            {selectedDuration !== "All" && <span className="glow-tag">{selectedDuration}</span>}
            {selectedDecade !== "All" && <span className="glow-tag">{selectedDecade}</span>}
            <span className="plain-tag">Sort: {sortBy}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="premium-movie-grid">
            {movies.map((movie, index) => {
              const isLast = movies.length === index + 1;
              return (
                <Link 
                  to={`/movie/${movie.movie_id}`} 
                  key={movie.movie_id} 
                  ref={isLast ? lastMovieElementRef : null} 
                  className="premium-movie-card"
                >
                  <div className="card-img-wrapper">
                    <img src={movie.poster_url} alt={movie.title} loading="lazy" />
                    <div className="card-overlay">
                      <span className="play-btn">▶</span>
                    </div>
                    {movie.avg_rating && (
                      <div className="rating-badge">★ {Number(movie.avg_rating).toFixed(1)}</div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="card-info">
                    <h4>{movie.title}</h4>
                    <p>{movie.release_year} • Movie</p>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {loading && (
            <div className="ex-loader">
              <div className="spinner"></div>
              <span>Discovering movies...</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {!hasMore && movies.length > 0 && (
            <div className="end-msg">🎉 You've explored all movies in this category!</div>
          )}
          {!loading && movies.length === 0 && (
            <div className="empty-state">No movies found for these filters.</div>
          )}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/pages/Watchlist.jsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { getWatchlist, removeFromWatchlist } from "../services/homeService";
import Navbar from "../components/Navbar";
import SearchModal from "../components/SearchModal";
import "../styles/watchlist.css";

export default function Watchlist() {
  const [movies, setMovies] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSearchOpen, setIsSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sortOption, setSortOption] = useState("recent");

  useEffect(() => {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    fetchWatchlist();
  }, []);

  const fetchWatchlist = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const data = await getWatchlist();
    setMovies(data);
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const handleRemove = async (movieId, e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); 
    const success = await removeFromWatchlist(movieId);
    if (success) {
      // UI se turant hata do bina page refresh kiye
      setMovies(movies.filter(m => m.movie_id !== movieId));
    }
  };

  // UI Sorting Logic
  const sortedMovies = [...movies].sort((a, b) => {
    if (sortOption === "recent") return new Date(b.added_at) - new Date(a.added_at);
    if (sortOption === "rating") return (b.avg_rating || 0) - (a.avg_rating || 0);
    if (sortOption === "alpha") return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
    return 0;
  });

  return (
    <div className="watchlist-page">
      <Navbar onOpenSearch={() => setIsSearchOpen(true)} />
      <SearchModal isOpen={isSearchOpen} onClose={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)} />

      <div className="wl-container">
        <header className="wl-header">
          <h1>My Watchlist</h1>
          <p>Your curated collection of must-see movies ({movies.length} items).</p>
          
          <div className="wl-filters">
            <div className="wl-sort-group">
              <span className="wl-label">Sort by:</span>
              <select className="wl-select" value={sortOption} onChange={(e) => setSortOption(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="recent">Recently Added</option>
                <option value="rating">Highest Rated</option>
                <option value="alpha">Alphabetical</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {loading ? (
          <h2 className="loading-text">Loading Collection...</h2>
        ) : movies.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="wl-empty">
            <h2>Your watchlist is empty!</h2>
            <Link to="/home" className="btn-explore">Explore Movies</Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="wl-grid">
            {sortedMovies.map((movie) => (
              <Link to={`/movie/${movie.movie_id}`} key={movie.movie_id} className="wl-card">
                <img src={movie.poster_url} alt={movie.title} className="wl-poster" />
                
                {/* 🌟 NAYA: THE PREMIUM HOVER OVERLAY */}
                <div className="wl-overlay">
                  <div className="wl-overlay-content">
                    <h3 className="wl-title">{movie.title}</h3>
                    <div className="wl-stars">
                      {"★".repeat(Math.floor(movie.avg_rating || 0))}
                      <span className="wl-rating-num">{movie.avg_rating}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="wl-synopsis">
                      {movie.overview?.length > 70 ? movie.overview.substring(0, 70) + '...' : movie.overview || "No overview available."}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="wl-actions">
                    <button className="wl-btn-watched" onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); alert('Moved to Watched!'); }}>
                      Mark as Watched ✔
                    </button>
                    <button className="wl-btn-remove" onClick={(e) => handleRemove(movie.movie_id, e)}>
                      Remove 🔖
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/explore.css">
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

.explore-wrapper {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background-color: #050507; /* Deep cinematic black */
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
}

.explore-layout {
  display: flex;
  max-width: 1400px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 30px 20px;
  gap: 40px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* --- PREMUM SIDEBAR --- */
.explore-sidebar {
  flex: 0 0 280px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 90px;
  background: rgba(18, 18, 22, 0.6);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 16px;
  height: calc(100vh - 120px); /* Fit to screen height */
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.filter-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 25px 25px 15px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.filter-header h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.filter-header h3 span {
  font-size: 10px;
  background: #9b5cff;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.clear-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: #666;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 0.2s;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.clear-btn:hover { color: #ff4757; }

/* Custom Scrollbar for Sidebar */
.filter-scroll-area {
  padding: 25px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  flex: 1;
}
.filter-scroll-area::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
.filter-scroll-area::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
.filter-scroll-area::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #333; border-radius: 4px; }

/* Filter Inputs */
.filter-section { margin-bottom: 30px; }

.filter-section label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #888;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

/* Custom Select Dropdowns */
.custom-select-wrapper {
  position: relative;
}
.custom-select-wrapper::after {
  content: '▼';
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #888;
  position: absolute;
  right: 15px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.filter-select {
  appearance: none;
  width: 100%;
  background: #111114;
  color: #ddd;
  border: 1px solid #222;
  padding: 12px 15px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.3s;
}
.filter-select:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #9b5cff;
}

/* Badges (Genre) */
.genre-badges-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.filter-badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: #111114;
  border: 1px solid #222;
  color: #aaa;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.filter-badge:hover {
  background: #1a1a20;
  color: #fff;
}

.filter-badge.active {
  background: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.1);
  border-color: #9b5cff;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.15);
}

.active-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  background: #9b5cff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #9b5cff;
}

/* Duration Pills */
.duration-pills {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
}
.dur-pill {
  background: #111114;
  border: 1px solid #222;
  color: #888;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: 0.2s;
}
.dur-pill.active {
  background: #fff;
  color: #000;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* --- MAIN GRID AREA --- */
.explore-main { 
  flex: 1;
  margin-top: 60px; }

.active-tags-bar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.glow-tag {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.2), rgba(71, 184, 255, 0.2));
  border: 1px solid rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.5);
  color: #e5d4ff;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.1);
}

.plain-tag {
  color: #888;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border: 1px solid #333;
  border-radius: 20px;
}

/* Premium Grid */
.premium-movie-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 25px;
}

.premium-movie-card {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  group: hover;
  animation: scaleUp 0.4s ease-out backwards;
}

/* Image Wrapper with Hover Magic */
.card-img-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 2/3;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}

.card-img-wrapper img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
}

.premium-movie-card:hover .card-img-wrapper img {
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

/* Gradient Overlay & Play Button */
.card-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.9) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%);
  opacity: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

.premium-movie-card:hover .card-overlay {
  opacity: 1;
}

.play-btn {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  width: 45px; height: 45px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #fff;
  transform: translateY(20px);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.premium-movie-card:hover .play-btn {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* Rating Badge */
.rating-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px; right: 10px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
  backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
  color: #f5c518;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}

/* Info text */
.card-info h4 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.card-info p {
  margin: 4px 0 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #888;
}

/* --- LOADERS & MESSAGES --- */
.ex-loader {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 40px;
  color: #9b5cff;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.spinner {
  width: 30px; height: 30px;
  border: 3px solid rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.2);
  border-top-color: #9b5cff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 1s infinite linear;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes scaleUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }

.end-msg, .empty-state {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 40px;
  color: #888;
  font-size: 15px;
}

/* ==============================
   SIMPLE SURPRISE ME BUTTON
================================= */
.surprise-me-box-container {
  margin-top: 30px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  width: 100%;
}

.btn-surprise-me-simple {
  width: 100%;
  background-color: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.1); /* Halka transparent purple */
  color: #9b5cff; /* Tera theme wala original purple */
  border: 1px solid rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.4);
  padding: 12px 0; /* Height ekdum normal kar di */
  border-radius: 8px; /* Clean edges */
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.btn-surprise-me-simple:hover {
  background-color: #9b5cff; /* Hover karne par poora purple ban jayega */
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.3); /* Halka sa glow */
}

.btn-surprise-me-simple:active {
  transform: scale(0.97); /* Click karne par halke se dabega */
}

/* ==============================
   SURPRISE RESULT MINI CARD
================================= */
.surprise-result-card {
  margin-top: 15px;
  background: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.3);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  position: relative;
  animation: slideDownFade 0.4s ease;
}

.surprise-poster {
  width: 65px;
  height: 95px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  object-fit: cover;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.surprise-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: 1;
}

.surprise-info h4 {
  margin: 0 0 4px 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #fff;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.surprise-info p {
  margin: 0 0 10px 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #aaa;
}

.btn-view-surprise {
  background: #9b5cff;
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-view-surprise:hover {
  background: #7a3edb;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.4);
}

.close-surprise {
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px;
  right: 5px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: #888;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 14px;
  padding: 4px;
}

.close-surprise:hover {
  color: #fff;
}

@keyframes slideDownFade {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/genre-selection.css">
/* ================================= */
/* GENRE SELECTION PAGE */
/* ================================= */

.genre-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  width: 100%;

  position: relative;

  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;

  overflow-x: hidden;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 50% 15%,
      rgba(125, 55, 255, 0.13),
      transparent 35%
    ),
    #050505;

  color: #ffffff;

  font-family:
    Inter,
    Arial,
    sans-serif;
}


/* ================================= */
/* BACKGROUND GLOW */
/* ================================= */

.genre-glow {
  position: fixed;

  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;

  border-radius: 50%;

  filter: blur(120px);

  pointer-events: none;

  opacity: 0.12;
}

.genre-glow-one {
  top: 5%;
  left: -180px;

  background: #7c3aed;
}

.genre-glow-two {
  bottom: -150px;
  right: -150px;

  background: #9333ea;
}


/* ================================= */
/* MAIN CONTAINER */
/* ================================= */

.genre-container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;

  width: min(1000px, 92%);

  padding: 38px 0 45px;
}


/* ================================= */
/* LOGO */
/* ================================= */

.genre-logo {
  text-align: center;

  font-size: 21px;
  font-weight: 800;

  letter-spacing: 2px;

  color: #ffffff;

  margin-bottom: 38px;
}

.genre-logo span {
  color: #9b5cff;
}


/* ================================= */
/* HEADER */
/* ================================= */

.genre-header {
  text-align: center;

  max-width: 600px;

  margin: 0 auto 30px;
}


.genre-icon {
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;

  margin: 0 auto 15px;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  border-radius: 14px;

  background: rgba(130, 70, 255, 0.12);

  border: 1px solid rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.22);

  font-size: 21px;

  box-shadow:
    0 0 25px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.12);
}


.genre-header h1 {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 34px;

  font-weight: 700;

  letter-spacing: -0.7px;
}


.genre-header p {
  margin: 11px auto 0;

  max-width: 520px;

  color: #918b9d;

  font-size: 14px;

  line-height: 1.6;
}


/* ================================= */
/* SELECTION INFO */
/* ================================= */

.selection-info {
  display: flex;

  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;

  margin-bottom: 14px;

  padding: 0 3px;

  color: #77717f;

  font-size: 12px;
}


.selection-info strong {
  color: #a875ff;

  font-weight: 600;
}


/* ================================= */
/* GENRES GRID */
/* ================================= */

.genres-grid {
  display: grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(6, 1fr);

  gap: 11px;
}


/* ================================= */
/* GENRE CARD */
/* ================================= */

.genre-card {
  position: relative;

  min-height: 78px;

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  gap: 7px;

  padding: 10px;

  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);

  border-radius: 14px;

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);

  color: #d5d0dc;

  cursor: pointer;

  transition:
    transform 0.2s ease,
    border-color 0.2s ease,
    background 0.2s ease,
    box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}


.genre-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);

  border-color: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.35);

  background: rgba(130, 70, 255, 0.07);
}


/* ================================= */
/* ICON */
/* ================================= */

.genre-card-icon {
  font-size: 20px;

  line-height: 1;
}


/* ================================= */
/* NAME */
/* ================================= */

.genre-name {
  font-size: 12px;

  font-weight: 500;
}


/* ================================= */
/* SELECTED */
/* ================================= */

.genre-card.selected {
  border-color: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.75);

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.20),
      rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.08)
    );

  color: #ffffff;

  box-shadow:
    0 0 22px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.13);
}


.genre-card.selected:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}


/* ================================= */
/* CHECK */
/* ================================= */

.genre-check {
  position: absolute;

  top: 7px;
  right: 8px;

  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  border-radius: 50%;

  background: #8b4dff;

  color: white;

  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
}


/* ================================= */
/* BOTTOM */
/* ================================= */

.genre-bottom {
  display: flex;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

  margin-top: 24px;
}


.genre-hint,
.genre-ready {
  margin: 0;

  color: #77717f;

  font-size: 12px;
}


.genre-ready {
  color: #70d9a0;
}


/* ================================= */
/* CONTINUE BUTTON */
/* ================================= */

.continue-button {
  min-width: 145px;

  height: 44px;

  display: flex;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  gap: 10px;

  border: none;

  border-radius: 10px;

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);

  color: #66616d;

  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;

  cursor: not-allowed;
}


.continue-button.active {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #7438dc,
      #9b5cff
    );

  color: white;

  cursor: pointer;

  box-shadow:
    0 8px 25px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.22);

  transition: 0.2s ease;
}


.continue-button.active:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);

  box-shadow:
    0 12px 30px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.32);
}


.continue-button span {
  font-size: 17px;
}


/* ================================= */
/* RESPONSIVE */
/* ================================= */

@media (max-width: 850px) {

  .genres-grid {
    grid-template-columns:
      repeat(4, 1fr);
  }

}


@media (max-width: 600px) {

  .genre-container {
    width: 90%;

    padding-top: 25px;
  }

  .genre-header h1 {
    font-size: 28px;
  }

  .genres-grid {
    grid-template-columns:
      repeat(3, 1fr);

    gap: 9px;
  }

  .genre-card {
    min-height: 72px;
  }

  .genre-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;

    gap: 15px;

    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .genre-hint,
  .genre-ready {
    text-align: center;
  }

  .continue-button {
    width: 100%;
  }

}


@media (max-width: 400px) {

  .genres-grid {
    grid-template-columns:
      repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/global.css">
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body,
#root {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100%;
}

body {
    margin: 0;
    background: #07070a;
    color: white;
    font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif;

    overflow-x: hidden;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/loader.css">
/* loader.css */
.cinematic-loader-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100vh;
  background-color: #050507;
}

.cinematic-spinner {
  width: 55px;
  height: 55px;
  border: 4px solid rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.2);
  border-top-color: #9b5cff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 1s ease-in-out infinite;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

@keyframes spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.loader-text {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #888;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  animation: pulse 1.5s infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; }
  50% { opacity: 1; }
}

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/signup.css">
/* ============================= */
/* SIGNUP PAGE */
/* ============================= */

.signup-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  background: #050505;
  overflow: hidden;
}


/* ============================= */
/* LEFT SIDE */
/* ============================= */

.signup-left {
  width: 55%;
  min-height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}


/* ============================= */
/* RIGHT SIDE */
/* ============================= */

.signup-right {
  width: 45%;
  min-height: 100vh;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  padding: 40px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 30% 50%,
      rgba(130, 60, 255, 0.15),
      transparent 55%
    ),
    #070707;
}


/* ============================= */
/* CARD */
/* ============================= */

.signup-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 430px;

  padding: 38px;

  border-radius: 24px;

  background: rgba(20, 15, 30, 0.72);

  border: 1px solid rgba(170, 100, 255, 0.18);

  box-shadow:
    0 25px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    0 0 40px rgba(120, 60, 255, 0.08);

  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}


/* ============================= */
/* TITLE */
/* ============================= */

.signup-card h1 {
  margin: 0;

  color: #ffffff;

  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 700;
}


/* ============================= */
/* SUBTITLE */
/* ============================= */

.signup-subtitle {
  margin-top: 9px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;

  color: #9d98a8;

  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}


/* ============================= */
/* INPUT GROUP */
/* ============================= */

.signup-input-group {
  margin-bottom: 17px;
}


.signup-input-group label {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 7px;

  color: #c9c4d3;

  font-size: 13px;
}


/* ============================= */
/* INPUT WRAPPER */
/* ============================= */

.signup-input-wrapper {
  height: 48px;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;

  padding: 0 13px;

  border-radius: 11px;

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);

  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);

  transition: 0.2s ease;
}


.signup-input-wrapper:focus-within {
  border-color: rgba(150, 80, 255, 0.65);

  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px rgba(130, 60, 255, 0.08);
}


/* ============================= */
/* ICON */
/* ============================= */

.signup-input-icon {
  margin-right: 10px;

  font-size: 15px;

  opacity: 0.7;
}


/* ============================= */
/* INPUT */
/* ============================= */

.signup-input-wrapper input {
  flex: 1;

  width: 100%;

  border: none;
  outline: none;

  background: transparent;

  color: #ffffff;

  font-size: 14px;
}


.signup-input-wrapper input::placeholder {
  color: #77727f;
}


/* ============================= */
/* PASSWORD EYE */
/* ============================= */

.signup-eye-button {
  border: none;

  background: transparent;

  color: #9993a5;

  cursor: pointer;

  font-size: 15px;

  padding: 4px;
}


.signup-eye-button:hover {
  color: #c9a7ff;
}


/* ============================= */
/* ERROR */
/* ============================= */

.signup-error {
  margin-top: 5px;
  margin-bottom: 15px;

  color: #ff6b8a;

  font-size: 13px;
}


/* ============================= */
/* SUCCESS */
/* ============================= */

.signup-success {
  margin-top: 5px;
  margin-bottom: 15px;

  color: #72e6a5;

  font-size: 13px;
}


/* ============================= */
/* BUTTON */
/* ============================= */

.signup-button {
  width: 100%;

  height: 48px;

  border: none;

  border-radius: 11px;

  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #7c3aed,
    #9b5cff
  );

  color: white;

  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;

  cursor: pointer;

  transition: 0.2s ease;

  box-shadow:
    0 8px 25px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.25);
}


.signup-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);

  box-shadow:
    0 12px 30px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.35);
}


.signup-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.65;

  cursor: not-allowed;

  transform: none;
}


/* ============================= */
/* LOGIN LINK */
/* ============================= */

.login-text {
  margin-top: 22px;

  display: flex;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  gap: 6px;

  color: #85808e;

  font-size: 13px;
}


.login-text a {
  color: #b88aff;

  text-decoration: none;

  font-weight: 600;
}


.login-text a:hover {
  color: #d0b4ff;
}


/* ============================= */
/* RESPONSIVE */
/* ============================= */

@media (max-width: 900px) {

  .signup-left {
    display: none;
  }

  .signup-right {
    width: 100%;
  }

}


@media (max-width: 500px) {

  .signup-right {
    padding: 20px;
  }

  .signup-card {
    padding: 28px 22px;
  }

  .signup-card h1 {
    font-size: 27px;
  }

}

import pandas as pd

movies = pd.read_csv(
    "../dataset/processed/movieverse_master_dataset.csv"
)

movies.head()


movies.info()



movies.shape


movies.columns.tolist()








columns_to_check = [
    "genres",
    "languages",
    "countries",
    "studios",
    "themes"
]

for column in columns_to_check:

    unique_values = (
        movies[column]
        .dropna()
        .str.split(" | ", regex=False)
        .explode()
        .nunique()
    )

    print(f"{column}: {unique_values:,} unique values")






genres_table = (
    movies["genres"]
    .dropna()
    .str.split(" | ", regex=False)
    .explode()
    .drop_duplicates()
    .sort_values()
    .reset_index(drop=True)
    .to_frame(name="genre_name")
)

genres_table.insert(0, "genre_id", range(1, len(genres_table) + 1))

genres_table.head()


genres_table.shape





genres_table.to_csv(
    "../dataset/database/genres.csv",
    index=False
)

print("Genres Table Saved")





genre_map = dict(
    zip(
        genres_table["genre_name"],
        genres_table["genre_id"]
    )
)

list(genre_map.items())[:5]





movie_genres = (
    movies[
        ["movie_id", "genres"]
    ]
    .dropna()
)

movie_genres["genres"] = movie_genres["genres"].str.split(" | ", regex=False)

movie_genres = movie_genres.explode("genres")

movie_genres["genre_id"] = movie_genres["genres"].map(genre_map)

movie_genres = movie_genres[
    ["movie_id", "genre_id"]
]


movie_genres.head(10)


movie_genres.shape


movie_genres.duplicated().sum()





movie_genres.to_csv(

)

columns = [
    "genres",
    "main_cast",
    "director",
    "producer",
    "languages",
    "countries",
    "studios",
    "themes"
]

placeholders = [
    "Unknown",
    "N/A",
    "None",
    "-"
]

for col in columns:

    movies[col] = movies[col].replace(placeholders, pd.NA)


for col in columns:

    movies[col] = (
        movies[col]
        .replace(r'^\s*$', pd.NA, regex=True)
    )


movies = movies.dropna(
    subset=["title"]
)


movies.to_csv(
    "../dataset/processed/movieverse_master_dataset.csv",
    index=False
)

print("Final Clean Dataset Saved")

    .dropna()
    .str.split("|")
    .explode()
    .str.strip()
)

producers = producers[producers != ""]

producers = (
    producers
    .drop_duplicates()
    .sort_values()
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

producers = producers.to_frame(name="producer_name")

producers["producer_id"] = range(1, len(producers) + 1)

producers = producers[
    ["producer_id", "producer_name"]
]

producers.to_csv(
    "../dataset/processed/producers.csv",
    index=False
)

print("Producers Saved")
print(producers.shape)

producers.head()





producer_map = dict(
    zip(
        producers["producer_name"],
        producers["producer_id"]
    )
)





movie_producers = (
    movies[
        ["movie_id", "producer"]
    ]
    .dropna(subset=["producer"])
)

movie_producers["producer"] = (
    movie_producers["producer"]
    .str.split("|")
)

movie_producers = movie_producers.explode(
    "producer"
)

movie_producers["producer"] = (
    movie_producers["producer"]
    .str.strip()
)

movie_producers = movie_producers[
    movie_producers["producer"] != ""
]

movie_producers["producer_id"] = (
    movie_producers["producer"]
    .map(producer_map)
)

movie_producers = (
    movie_producers[
        ["movie_id", "producer_id"]
    ]
    .drop_duplicates()
)

movie_producers.to_csv(
    "../dataset/processed/movie_producers.csv",
    index=False
)

print("Movie Producers Saved")
print(movie_producers.shape)

movie_producers.head()


actors["actor_name"].str.len().max()


print(
    movies["main_cast"]
    .str.split("|")
    .explode()
    .str.strip()
    .duplicated()
    .sum()
)


actors = (
    movies["main_cast"]
    .dropna()
    .str.split("|")
    .explode()
    .str.strip()
)

print("Total:", len(actors))
print("Unique:", actors.nunique())


dup = actors[actors.duplicated("actor_name", keep=False)]

print(dup.shape)
print(dup[dup["actor_name"].str.contains("Weird Al", case=False, na=False)])


type(actors)


import pandas as pd

actors = pd.read_csv("../dataset/processed/actors.csv")

print(type(actors))
print(actors.columns)


dup = actors[actors.duplicated(subset=["actor_name"], keep=False)]

print("Duplicate rows:", len(dup))

print(
    dup[
        dup["actor_name"].str.contains(
            "Weird Al",
            case=False,
            na=False
        )
    ]
)

  {

   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "actors_work = actors[[\"id\", \"name\", \"role\"]].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "actors_work[\"name\"] = actors_work[\"name\"].fillna(\"\")\n",
    "actors_work[\"role\"] = actors_work[\"role\"].fillna(\"\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Har movie ke liye sirf pehle 7 actors lo\n",
    "actors_work[\"rank\"] = actors_work.groupby(\"id\").cumcount()\n",
    "\n",
    "actors_top7 = actors_work[actors_work[\"rank\"] < 7].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "actors_top7[\"cast_item\"] = (\n",
    "    actors_top7[\"name\"].str.strip() + \" as \" + actors_top7[\"role\"].str.strip()\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "actors_clean = (\n",
    "    actors_top7.groupby(\"id\", sort=False)[\"cast_item\"]\n",
    "    .agg(\" | \".join)\n",
    "    .reset_index(name=\"main_cast\")\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

    ")"

    "crew_work = crew.copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "crew_work.columns = [col.lower() for col in crew_work.columns]\n",
    "\n",
    "director_col = \"job\" if \"job\" in crew_work.columns else \"role\"\n",
    "\n",
    "director_df = crew_work[\n",
    "    crew_work[director_col].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains(\"director\", na=False)\n",
    "].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "director_clean = (\n",
    "    director_df.groupby(\"id\", sort=False)[\"name\"]\n",
    "    .agg(lambda x: \" | \".join(pd.unique(x)))\n",
    "    .reset_index(name=\"director\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "director_clean.head()"
   ]
  },

    "print(\"Total Movies:\", len(movies))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Runtime Missing:\",\n",
    "      movies[\"minute\"].isna().sum())\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Runtime < 60:\",\n",
    "      (movies[\"minute\"] < 60).sum())\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Runtime >= 60:\",\n",
    "      (movies[\"minute\"] >= 60).sum())\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Final:\",\n",
    "      len(movies[\n",
    "          movies[\"minute\"].notna() &\n",
    "          (movies[\"minute\"] >= 60)\n",
    "      ]))"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "movies_clean = movies.copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Sirf runtime 60 min se kam wali movies remove karo\n",
    "movies_clean = movies_clean[\n",
    "    (movies_clean[\"minute\"].isna()) |\n",
    "    (movies_clean[\"minute\"] >= 60)\n",
    "].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "movies_clean = movies_clean.rename(columns={\n",
    "    \"id\": \"movie_id\",\n",
    "    \"name\": \"title\",\n",
    "    \"date\": \"release_year\",\n",
    "    \"minute\": \"runtime_minutes\",\n",
    "    \"rating\": \"avg_rating\",\n",
    "    \"description\": \"overview\"\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "movies_clean[\"release_year\"] = movies_clean[\"release_year\"].astype(\"Int64\")\n",
    "movies_clean[\"runtime_minutes\"] = movies_clean[\"runtime_minutes\"].astype(\"Int64\")\n",
    "movies_clean[\"avg_rating\"] = movies_clean[\"avg_rating\"].astype(\"float\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(movies_clean.shape)\n",
    "movies_clean.head()"
   ]
  },

   ],
   "source": [
    "final_movies = movies_clean.merge(\n",
    "    genres_clean,\n",
    "    left_on=\"movie_id\",\n",
    "    right_on=\"id\",\n",
    "    how=\"left\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "final_movies = final_movies.merge(\n",
    "    actors_clean,\n",
    "    left_on=\"movie_id\",\n",
    "    right_on=\"id\",\n",
    "    how=\"left\",\n",
    "    suffixes=(\"\", \"_actors\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "final_movies = final_movies.merge(\n",
    "    posters_clean,\n",
    "    left_on=\"movie_id\",\n",
    "    right_on=\"id\",\n",
    "    how=\"left\",\n",
    "    suffixes=(\"\", \"_posters\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "final_movies = final_movies.merge(\n",
    "    director_clean,\n",
    "    left_on=\"movie_id\",\n",
    "    right_on=\"id\",\n",
    "    how=\"left\",\n",
    "    suffixes=(\"\", \"_director\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "final_movies = final_movies.merge(\n",
    "    producer_clean,\n",
    "    left_on=\"movie_id\",\n",
    "    right_on=\"id\",\n",
    "    how=\"left\",\n",
    "    suffixes=(\"\", \"_producer\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Extra id columns remove\n",
    "final_movies = final_movies.loc[:, ~final_movies.columns.str.startswith(\"id\")]\n",
    "\n",
    "print(final_movies.shape)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "hindi_ids = languages[\n",
    "    languages[\"language\"] == \"Hindi\"\n",
    "][\"id\"].unique()\n",
    "\n",
    "movies[movies[\"id\"].isin(hindi_ids)][\n",
    "    [\"id\", \"name\", \"date\"]\n",
    "].head(50)"
   ]

   "source": [

    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "final_movies = final_movies.drop(columns=[\"id\"])"
   ]

   "source": [
    "def clean_text(text):\n",
    "\n",
    "    text = text.lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    text = re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9\\s]\", \" \", text)\n",
    "\n",
    "    text = re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \" \", text)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return text.strip()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "bd355a96-69d2-4200-97d8-524f41474b7c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "for col in feature_columns:\n",
    "    movies[col] = movies[col].apply(clean_text)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "### Weighted Features"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "code",

   "id": "bb134e23-20f7-4ec5-a3dd-abb6ba6dc997",

   "source": [
    "def repeat_text(text, times):\n",
    "    if text.strip() == \"\":\n",
    "        return \"\"\n",
    "    return (\" \" + text) * times"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "c96c0f4b-a1f7-481e-b20d-087528af91fe",

    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "repeat_text(\"action adventure\", 3)"
   ]

    "movies[\"tags\"] = (\n",

    ")"

   "source": [
    "def remove_extra_duplicates(words, max_repeat=3):\n",
    "    \n",
    "    word_count = {}\n",
    "    result = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for word in words:\n",
    "\n",
    "        count = word_count.get(word, 0)\n",
    "\n",
    "        if count < max_repeat:\n",
    "            result.append(word)\n",
    "\n",
    "        word_count[word] = count + 1\n",
    "\n",
    "    return result"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 18,
   "id": "5d18febe-046e-4824-a897-6d21e4e55ed9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "movies[\"tags\"] = movies[\"tags\"].apply(remove_extra_duplicates)"
   ]
  },

   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "44a30dd3-606f-4812-9b58-0720eea14aeb",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(\n",
    "\n",
    "    max_features=25000,\n",
    "\n",
    "    stop_words=\"english\",\n",
    "\n",
    "    ngram_range=(1,2),\n",
    "\n",
    "    min_df=2\n",
    "\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "429278c1-cbf6-4fbd-bb52-98ced44685ec",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(570740, 25000)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 8,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "tfidf_matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform(\n",
    "    movies[\"tags\"]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "tfidf_matrix.shape"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "d61eba87-81e9-4375-9d4d-88acda2d5f59",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Model Ready\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "knn = NearestNeighbors(\n",
    "\n",
    "    metric=\"cosine\",\n",
    "\n",
    "    algorithm=\"brute\"\n",
    "\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "knn.fit(tfidf_matrix)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Model Ready\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "51f839ff-311a-45cd-a424-4e4045c3b1ea",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "movie_index = pd.Series(\n",
    "\n",
    "    movies.index,\n",
    "\n",
    "    index=movies[\"title\"].str.lower()\n",
    "\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "movie_index = movie_index[\n",
    "\n",
    "    ~movie_index.index.duplicated()\n",
    "\n",
    "]"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "9b96f193-8aee-4f03-8c16-3b33a69fa46f",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def recommend(\n",
    "\n",
    "    movie_name,\n",
    "\n",
    "    start=0,\n",
    "\n",
    "    limit=20\n",
    "\n",
    "):\n",
    "\n",
    "    movie_name = movie_name.lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not movie_name:\n",
    "        return \"Movie not found.\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if movie_name not in movie_index:\n",
    "        return \"Movie not found.\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    idx = movie_index[movie_name]\n",
    "\n",
    "    distances, indices = knn.kneighbors(\n",
    "\n",
    "        tfidf_matrix[idx],\n",
    "\n",
    "        n_neighbors=start+limit+1\n",
    "\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    indices = indices[0][1:]\n",
    "\n",
    "    distances = distances[0][1:]\n",
    "\n",
    "    recommendations = movies.iloc[indices].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "    recommendations[\"similarity\"] = 1 - distances\n",
    "\n",
    "    return recommendations.iloc[start:start+limit][\n",
    "\n",
    "        [\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"title\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"release_year\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"avg_rating\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"genres\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"similarity\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"poster_url\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    ]"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "def prefix_search(query):\n",
    "\n",
    "    query = query.lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    return movies[\n",
    "        movies[\"display_title\"]\n",
    "        .str.lower()\n",
    "        .str.startswith(query)\n",
    "    ]"
   ]
