  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 36,
   "id": "add19b23-e3b3-4d67-8438-dad7398e96b4",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "\n",
    "def search_movie(query, limit=10):\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    # Input Validation\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    query = query.strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "    if query == \"\":\n",
    "        return pd.DataFrame()\n",
    "\n",
    "    query_lower = query.lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    limit = max(1, min(limit, 50))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    # Prefix Search\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    prefix = movies[\n",
    "        movies[\"display_title\"]\n",
    "        .str.lower()\n",
    "        .str.startswith(query_lower, na=False)\n",
    "    ].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "    prefix[\"search_score\"] = 100\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    # Contains Search\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    contains = movies[\n",
    "        movies[\"display_title\"]\n",
    "        .str.lower()\n",
    "        .str.contains(query_lower, na=False)\n",
    "    ].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "    contains = contains[\n",
    "        ~contains.index.isin(prefix.index)\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    contains[\"search_score\"] = 95\n",
    "\n",
    "    combined = pd.concat([prefix, contains])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    # If enough results found\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    if len(combined) >= limit:\n",
    "\n",
    "        combined = combined.sort_values(\n",
    "            by=[\"search_score\", \"avg_rating\"],\n",
    "            ascending=[False, False],\n",
    "            na_position=\"last\"\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        return combined[\n",
    "            [\n",
    "                \"movie_id\",\n",
    "                \"title\",\n",
    "                \"display_title\",\n",
    "                \"release_year\",\n",
    "                \"avg_rating\",\n",
    "                \"poster_url\",\n",
    "                \"search_score\"\n",
    "            ]\n",
    "        ].head(limit)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    # RapidFuzz Search\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    fuzzy = process.extract(\n",
    "        query,\n",
    "        movies[\"display_title\"],\n",
    "        scorer=fuzz.WRatio,\n",
    "        limit=limit * 3\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    fuzzy = [\n",
    "        item\n",
    "        for item in fuzzy\n",
    "        if item[1] >= 70\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    fuzzy_rows = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for title, score, idx in fuzzy:\n",
    "\n",
    "        if idx in combined.index:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "\n",
    "        row = movies.iloc[idx].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "        row[\"search_score\"] = score\n",
    "\n",
    "        fuzzy_rows.append(row)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if len(fuzzy_rows):\n",
    "\n",
    "        fuzzy_rows = pd.DataFrame(fuzzy_rows)\n",
    "\n",
    "        final = pd.concat([combined, fuzzy_rows])\n",
    "\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "\n",
    "        final = combined\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    # Remove Duplicates\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    final = final.drop_duplicates(\n",
    "        subset=\"movie_id\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    # Sort Results\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    final = final.sort_values(\n",
    "        by=[\"search_score\", \"avg_rating\"],\n",
    "        ascending=[False, False],\n",
    "        na_position=\"last\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    # Return\n",
    "    # -----------------------------\n",
    "    return final[\n",
    "        [\n",
    "            \"movie_id\",\n",
    "            \"title\",\n",
    "            \"display_title\",\n",
    "            \"release_year\",\n",
    "            \"avg_rating\",\n",
    "            \"poster_url\",\n",
    "            \"search_score\"\n",
    "        ]\n",
    "    ].head(limit)\n",
    "\n"
   ]
  },

  {

   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",

      "Prefix Index Created\n",
      "Total Prefixes : 363,885\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from collections import defaultdict\n",
    "\n",
    "prefix_index = defaultdict(list)\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, title in enumerate(movies[\"display_title\"]):\n",
    "\n",
    "    if pd.isna(title):\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    title = title.lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    words = title.split()\n",
    "\n",
    "    for word in words:\n",
    "\n",
    "        for i in range(1, min(len(word), 6) + 1):\n",
    "\n",
    "            prefix = word[:i]\n",
    "\n",
    "            prefix_index[prefix].append(idx)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Prefix Index Created\")\n",
    "print(f\"Total Prefixes : {len(prefix_index):,}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 43,
   "id": "507ff340-eed3-4f35-969b-4a4e0e05ea74",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Prefix Index Saved\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import joblib\n",
    "\n",
    "joblib.dump(\n",
    "    prefix_index,\n",
    "    \"../models/prefix_index.pkl\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Prefix Index Saved\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 44,
   "id": "74832af9-0f50-4da4-b4ab-36a8b1ac39e2",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def fast_search(query):\n",
    "\n",
    "    query = query.lower().strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "    return prefix_index.get(query, [])"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import joblib\n",
    "import time"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "13950d27-7ba1-495c-8f78-6e4f4fcb0d93",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "movies = pd.read_pickle(\"../models/movies.pkl\")\n",
    "\n",
    "knn = joblib.load(\"../models/recommendation_model.pkl\")\n",
    "\n",
    "movie_index = joblib.load(\n",
    "    \"../models/movie_index.pkl\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "tfidf_matrix = joblib.load(\"../models/tfidf_matrix.pkl\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "61473114-600a-45f7-9179-c9c0a7d3adee",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def recommend(\n",
    "\n",
    "    movie_name,\n",
    "\n",
    "    start=0,\n",
    "\n",
    "    limit=20\n",
    "\n",
    "):\n",
    "\n",
    "    movie_name = movie_name.lower()\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not movie_name:\n",
    "        return \"Movie not found.\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    if movie_name not in movie_index:\n",
    "        return \"Movie not found.\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    idx = movie_index[movie_name]\n",
    "\n",
    "    distances, indices = knn.kneighbors(\n",
    "\n",
    "        tfidf_matrix[idx],\n",
    "\n",
    "        n_neighbors=start+limit+1\n",
    "\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    indices = indices[0][1:]\n",
    "\n",
    "    distances = distances[0][1:]\n",
    "\n",
    "    recommendations = movies.iloc[indices].copy()\n",
    "    recommendations[\"similarity\"] = 1 - distances\n",
    "\n",
    "    return recommendations.iloc[start:start+limit][\n",
    "\n",
    "        [\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"title\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"release_year\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"avg_rating\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"genres\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"similarity\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"poster_url\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    ]"
   ]
  },

   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "7e043015-77ab-46cf-bba6-a99d36692f7b",

    "for movie in test_movies:\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"=\"*80)\n",

   "source": [
    "times = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for movie in test_movies:\n",
    "\n",
    "    start = time.time()\n",
    "\n",
    "    recommend(movie)\n",
    "\n",
    "    end = time.time()\n",
    "\n",
    "    times.append(end-start)"
   ]
  },

    "# \n",
    "MovieVerse Database Design\n",
    "\n",
    "Tables\n",
    "\n",
    "1. movies\n",
    "2. users\n",
    "3. ratings\n",
    "4. reviews\n",
    "5. watchlist\n",
    "6. favorites\n",
    "7. search_history\n",
    "8. user_activity\n",
    "\n",
    "| Column          | Type         |\n",
    "| --------------- | ------------ |\n",
    "| movie_id        | BIGINT       |\n",
    "| title           | VARCHAR(255) |\n",
    "| release_year    | YEAR         |\n",
    "| tagline         | TEXT         |\n",
    "| overview        | LONGTEXT     |\n",
    "| runtime_minutes | INT          |\n",
    "| avg_rating      | FLOAT        |\n",
    "| genres          | TEXT         |\n",
    "| main_cast       | LONGTEXT     |\n",

    "| studios         | TEXT         |\n",
    "| themes          | TEXT         |\n"
   ]

    "    movies[\"genres\"]\n",

<file path="backend/routes/movies.py">
from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request
from sqlalchemy import text
from backend.database import engine

movies_bp = Blueprint("movies", __name__)

@movies_bp.route("/movies", methods=["GET"])
def get_movies():

    page = request.args.get("page", default=1, type=int)
    limit = request.args.get("limit", default=20, type=int)

    if page < 1:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Page must be at least 1"
        }), 400

    if limit < 1:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Limit must be at least 1"
        }), 400

    if limit > 50:
        limit = 50

    offset = (page - 1) * limit

    query = text("""
        SELECT
            movie_id,
            title,
            release_year,
            avg_rating,
            poster_url
        FROM movies
        ORDER BY avg_rating DESC
        LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
    """)

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        movies = conn.execute(
            query,
            {
                "limit": limit,
                "offset": offset
            }
        ).mappings().all()

    return jsonify({
        "page": page,
        "limit": limit,
        "movies": [dict(movie) for movie in movies]
    }), 200
@movies_bp.route("/movies/trending", methods=["GET"])
def trending_movies():

    limit = request.args.get("limit", default=10, type=int)

    if limit < 1:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Limit must be at least 1"
        }), 400

    if limit > 20:
        limit = 20

    with engine.connect() as conn:

        movies = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT
                    movie_id,
                    title,
                    release_year,
                    avg_rating,
                    poster_url
                FROM movies
                WHERE avg_rating IS NOT NULL
                ORDER BY avg_rating DESC
                LIMIT :limit
            """),
            {
                "limit": limit
            }
        ).mappings().all()

    return jsonify({
        "total_movies": len(movies),
        "movies": [dict(movie) for movie in movies]
    }), 200
</file>

from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, g
from backend.database import engine
from sqlalchemy import text
from backend.middleware.auth_middleware import token_required

preferences_bp = Blueprint("preferences", __name__)

@preferences_bp.route("/preferences", methods=["POST"])
@token_required
def save_preferences():
    user_id = g.user_id
    data = request.get_json()
    genres = data.get("genres", [])

    print(f"👉 SAVING PREFERENCES -> User ID: {user_id}, Genres: {genres}") # 👈 Yeh add karo

    if not data:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Request body is required"
        }), 400

    # genres = data.get("genres")

    if not genres or not isinstance(genres, list):
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Genres must be provided as a list"
        }), 400

    if len(genres) < 3:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Please select at least 3 genres"
        }), 400

    # Clean, strip, and remove duplicate genres
    cleaned_genres = list(dict.fromkeys(
        genre.strip()
        for genre in genres
        if isinstance(genre, str) and genre.strip()
    ))

    if len(cleaned_genres) < 3:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Please select at least 3 valid genres"
        }), 400

    favorite_genre = ", ".join(cleaned_genres)

    try:
        # Check if preferences already exist for this user
        with engine.connect() as conn:
            existing = conn.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT id
                    FROM user_preference
                    WHERE user_id = :user_id
                """),
                {"user_id": user_id}
            ).first()

        # Update or Insert preferences inside a transaction block
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            if existing:
                conn.execute(
                    text("""
                        UPDATE user_preference
                        SET favorite_genre = :favorite_genre
                        WHERE user_id = :user_id
                    """),
                    {
                        "favorite_genre": favorite_genre,
                        "user_id": user_id
                    }
                )
            else:
                conn.execute(
                    text("""
                        INSERT INTO user_preference (user_id, favorite_genre)
                        VALUES (:user_id, :favorite_genre)
                    """),
                    {
                        "user_id": user_id,
                        "favorite_genre": favorite_genre
                    }
                )

        return jsonify({
            "message": "Preferences saved successfully",
            "user_id": user_id,
            "favorite_genre": favorite_genre
        }), 200

    except Exception as e:
        print("SAVE PREFERENCES ERROR:", e)
        return jsonify({
            "error": "An internal error occurred while saving preferences"
        }), 500

<file path="backend/routes/watchlist.py">
from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, g
from sqlalchemy import text

from backend.database import engine
from backend.middleware.auth_middleware import token_required


watchlist_bp = Blueprint("watchlist", __name__)


# Add movie to watchlist
@watchlist_bp.route("/watchlist/<int:movie_id>", methods=["POST"])
@token_required
def add_to_watchlist(movie_id):

    user_id = g.user_id

    # Check movie exists
    with engine.connect() as conn:

        movie = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT movie_id, title
                FROM movies
                WHERE movie_id = :movie_id
            """),
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).first()

    if movie is None:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Movie not found"
        }), 404

    # Add to watchlist
    try:

        with engine.begin() as conn:

            conn.execute(
                text("""
                    INSERT INTO watchlist (user_id, movie_id)
                    VALUES (:user_id, :movie_id)
                """),
                {
                    "user_id": user_id,
                    "movie_id": movie_id
                }
            )

    except Exception:

        return jsonify({
            "error": "Movie already exists in your watchlist"
        }), 409

    return jsonify({
        "message": "Movie added to watchlist",
        "movie_id": movie_id,
        "title": movie.title
    }), 201


# Get user's watchlist
@watchlist_bp.route("/watchlist", methods=["GET"])
@token_required
def get_watchlist():

    user_id = g.user_id

    with engine.connect() as conn:

        movies = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT
                    m.movie_id,
                    m.title,
                    m.release_year,
                    m.avg_rating,
                    m.poster_url,
                    m.overview,   
                    w.added_at
                FROM watchlist w
                JOIN movies m
                    ON w.movie_id = m.movie_id
                WHERE w.user_id = :user_id
                ORDER BY w.added_at DESC
            """),
            {"user_id": user_id}
        ).mappings().all()

    # Convert SQLAlchemy RowMapping to normal dictionaries
    watchlist = [dict(movie) for movie in movies]

    return jsonify({
        "watchlist": watchlist
    }), 200

# Remove movie from watchlist
@watchlist_bp.route("/watchlist/<int:movie_id>", methods=["DELETE"])
@token_required
def remove_from_watchlist(movie_id):

    user_id = g.user_id

    with engine.begin() as conn:

        result = conn.execute(
            text("""
                DELETE FROM watchlist
                WHERE user_id = :user_id
                AND movie_id = :movie_id
            """),
            {
                "user_id": user_id,
                "movie_id": movie_id
            }
        )

    if result.rowcount == 0:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Movie not found in your watchlist"
        }), 404

    return jsonify({
        "message": "Movie removed from watchlist",
        "movie_id": movie_id
    }), 200

<file path="backend/services/movie_service.py">
from sqlalchemy import text
from backend.database import engine




def get_movie(movie_id):

    query = text("""
        SELECT
            movie_id,
            title,
            release_year,
            tagline,
            overview,
            runtime_minutes,
            avg_rating,
            poster_url
        FROM movies
        WHERE movie_id = :movie_id
    """)

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        movie = conn.execute(
            query,
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).mappings().first()

    if movie is None:
        return None

    movie = dict(movie)

    movie["genres"] = get_movie_genres(movie_id)
    movie["directors"] = get_movie_directors(movie_id)
    movie["cast"] = get_movie_cast(movie_id)
    movie["languages"] = get_movie_languages(movie_id)
    movie["countries"] = get_movie_countries(movie_id)
    movie["producers"] = get_movie_producers(movie_id)
    movie["themes"] = get_movie_themes(movie_id)

    return movie

def get_movie_genres(movie_id):

    query = text("""
        SELECT g.genre_name
        FROM movie_genres mg
        JOIN genres g
            ON mg.genre_id = g.genre_id
        WHERE mg.movie_id = :movie_id
    """)

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            query,
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).fetchall()

    return [row[0] for row in rows]

def get_movie_directors(movie_id):

    query = text("""
        SELECT d.director_name
        FROM movie_directors md
        JOIN directors d
            ON md.director_id = d.director_id
        WHERE md.movie_id = :movie_id
    """)

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            query,
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).fetchall()

    return [row[0] for row in rows]

def get_movie_cast(movie_id):

    query = text("""
        SELECT
            a.actor_name,
            ma.role
        FROM movie_actors ma
        JOIN actors a
            ON ma.actor_id = a.actor_id
        WHERE ma.movie_id = :movie_id
        LIMIT 20
    """)

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            query,
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).mappings().all()

    return [dict(row) for row in rows]

def get_movie_languages(movie_id):

    query = text("""
        SELECT l.language_name
        FROM movie_languages ml
        JOIN languages l
            ON ml.language_id = l.language_id
        WHERE ml.movie_id = :movie_id
    """)

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            query,
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).fetchall()

    return [row[0] for row in rows]

def get_movie_countries(movie_id):

    query = text("""
        SELECT c.country_name
        FROM movie_countries mc
        JOIN countries c
            ON mc.country_id = c.country_id
        WHERE mc.movie_id = :movie_id
    """)

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            query,
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).fetchall()

    return [row[0] for row in rows]

def get_movie_producers(movie_id):

    query = text("""
        SELECT p.producer_name
        FROM movie_producers mp
        JOIN producers p
            ON mp.producer_id = p.producer_id
        WHERE mp.movie_id = :movie_id
    """)

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            query,
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).fetchall()

    return [row[0] for row in rows]

def get_movie_themes(movie_id):

    query = text("""
        SELECT t.theme_name
        FROM movie_themes mt
        JOIN themes t
            ON mt.theme_id = t.theme_id
        WHERE mt.movie_id = :movie_id
    """)

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            query,
            {"movie_id": movie_id}
        ).fetchall()

    return [row[0] for row in rows]

<file path="Frontend_react/src/components/SearchModal.jsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { performSearch, getSearchHistory, clearSearchHistory, toggleFollowUser } from "../services/homeService";
import "../styles/searchModal.css"; 

export default function SearchModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [searchType, setSearchType] = useState("movie"); // "movie" or "user"
  const [results, setResults] = useState([]);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [followStatus, setFollowStatus] = useState({}); // Tracking follow states

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      fetchHistory();
    } else {
      setSearchTerm("");
      setResults([]);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const fetchHistory = async () => {
    const hist = await getSearchHistory();
    setHistory(hist);
  };

  const handleClearHistory = async () => {
    const success = await clearSearchHistory();
    if (success) setHistory([]);
  };

  const handleFollowAction = async (e, userId) => {
    e.preventDefault(); // Link par click hone se roke
    e.stopPropagation();
    const res = await toggleFollowUser(userId);
    if (res && res.status) {
      setFollowStatus(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [userId]: res.status === "followed" ? "Following" : "Follow"
      }));
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const delayDebounceFn = setTimeout(async () => {
      if (searchTerm.trim().length > 1) {
        setLoading(true);
        const data = await performSearch(searchTerm, searchType);
        setResults(data);
        setLoading(false);
      } else {
        setResults([]);
      }
    }, 500); 

    return () => clearTimeout(delayDebounceFn);
  }, [searchTerm, searchType]); 

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="search-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="search-modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        
        <div className="search-input-wrapper">
          <svg className="search-icon-inside" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#888" strokeWidth="2">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle>
            <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line>
          </svg>
          <input 
            type="text" 
            placeholder={`Search for ${searchType}s...`} 
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            autoFocus
          />
          <button className="close-search-btn" onClick={onClose}>ESC</button>
        </div>

        <div className="search-tabs">
          <button 
            className={`s-tab ${searchType === "movie" ? "active" : ""}`}
            onClick={() => setSearchType("movie")}
          >Movies</button>
          <button className={`s-tab ${searchType === "actor" ? "active" : ""}`} onClick={() => setSearchType("actor")}>Actors</button>
          <button 
            className={`s-tab ${searchType === "user" ? "active" : ""}`}
            onClick={() => setSearchType("user")}
          >Users</button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="search-results-container">
          {loading && <p className="search-msg">Searching...</p>}
          
          {!loading && searchTerm.length < 2 && history.length > 0 && (
            <div className="search-history-section">
              <div className="sh-header">
                <h4>Recent Searches</h4>
                <button onClick={handleClearHistory} className="clear-hist-btn">Clear All</button>
              </div>
              {history.slice(0, 5).map(item => (
                <div 
                  key={item.history_id} 
                  className="history-item"
                  onClick={() => setSearchTerm(item.search_query)}
                >
                  🕒 {item.search_query}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {!loading && searchTerm.length > 1 && results.length === 0 && (
            <p className="search-msg">No {searchType} found. Try another term!</p>
          )}

          {!loading && results.length > 0 && (
            <div className="results-grid">
              {results.map((item, idx) => {
                if (searchType === "movie") {
                  return (
                    <Link to={`/movie/${item.movie_id}`} key={idx} className="search-result-card" onClick={onClose}>
                      <div className="src-poster-wrapper">
                        <img src={item.poster_url} alt={item.title} className="src-poster" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="src-info">
                        <h4>{item.title}</h4>
                        <span>{item.release_year} • ⭐ {item.avg_rating}</span>
                      </div>
                    </Link>
                  );
                } else if (searchType === "user") {
                  return (
                    <Link to={`/profile/${item.user_id}`} key={idx} className="search-result-card" onClick={onClose}>
                      <div className="src-avatar">
                        {item.username.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                      </div>
                      <div className="src-info">
                        <h4>@{item.username}</h4>
                      </div>
                    </Link>
                  );
                } else {
                  // Actors Search Result Card
                  return (
                    <Link to={`/actor/${encodeURIComponent(item.actor_name.split(" as ")[0])}`} key={idx} className="search-result-card" onClick={onClose}>
                      <div className="src-avatar" style={{ background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1a4a6e, #1db954)" }}>
                        {item.actor_name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                      </div>
                      <div className="src-info">
                        <h4 style={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}>
                          {item.actor_name.split(" as ")[0]}
                        </h4>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "#888" }}>Actor / Cast</span>
                      </div>
                    </Link>
                  );
                }
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/pages/ActorProfile.jsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { useParams, Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { getActorMovies } from "../services/homeService";
import Navbar from "../components/Navbar";
import SearchModal from "../components/SearchModal"; // 👈 Import added

export default function Actor() {
  const params = useParams();
  const name = params.name || params.actorName || params.actor || Object.values(params)[0];
  const [movies, setMovies] = useState([]);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState("year");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);
  
  // 🌟 Search Modal State Added
  const [isSearchOpen, setIsSearchOpen] = useState(false);

  const observer = useRef();
  const lastMovieElementRef = useCallback(node => {
    if (loading) return;
    if (observer.current) observer.current.disconnect();
    
    observer.current = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      if (entries[0].isIntersecting && hasMore) {
        setPage(prevPage => prevPage + 1);
      }
    });
    
    if (node) observer.current.observe(node);
  }, [loading, hasMore]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMovies([]);
    setPage(1);
    setHasMore(true);
  }, [sortBy, name]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchMovies = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      const newMovies = await getActorMovies(name, page, sortBy);
      
      if (newMovies.length === 0) {
        setHasMore(false);
      } else {
        setMovies(prevMovies => {
          const existingIds = new Set(prevMovies.map(m => m.movie_id));
          const filtered = newMovies.filter(m => !existingIds.has(m.movie_id));
          return [...prevMovies, ...filtered];
        });
      }
      setLoading(false);
    };
    
    fetchMovies();
  }, [name, page, sortBy]);

  return (
    <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: "#0a0a0f", color: "#fff", paddingBottom: "50px" }}>
      {/* 🌟 Passed onOpenSearch prop */}
      <Navbar onOpenSearch={() => setIsSearchOpen(true)} />
      
      <div style={{ maxWidth: "1200px", margin: "40px auto", padding: "0 20px" }}>
        
        {/* ================= HEADER SECTION ================= */}
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-end", marginBottom: "30px", borderBottom: "1px solid #333", paddingBottom: "20px" }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "20px" }}>
            <div style={{ 
              width: "80px", height: "80px", borderRadius: "50%", background: "#9b5cff", 
              display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", fontSize: "32px", fontWeight: "bold" 
            }}>
              {name ? name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : "?"}
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "32px" }}>{name || "Actor Profile"}</h1>
              <p style={{ margin: "5px 0 0 0", color: "#aaa" }}>Featured Movies & Filmography</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <select 
            value={sortBy} 
            onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value)}
            style={{ 
              background: "#1a1a22", color: "#fff", padding: "10px 16px", 
              border: "1px solid #333", borderRadius: "8px", outline: "none", cursor: "pointer", fontSize: "14px" 
            }}
          >
            <option value="year">Sort by Release Year</option>
            <option value="rating">Sort by Rating</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* ================= MOVIES GRID ================= */}
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr))", gap: "25px" }}>
          {movies.map((movie, index) => {
            const isLastElement = index === movies.length - 1;
            
            return (
              <Link 
                to={`/movie/${movie.movie_id}`} 
                key={`${movie.movie_id}-${index}`} 
                ref={isLastElement ? lastMovieElementRef : null}
                style={{ 
                  textDecoration: "none", color: "inherit", background: "#111", 
                  borderRadius: "10px", overflow: "hidden", transition: "transform 0.2s" 
                }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = "scale(1.05)"}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = "scale(1)"}
              >
                <img src={movie.poster_url} alt={movie.title} style={{ width: "100%", height: "300px", objectFit: "cover" }} />
                <div style={{ padding: "12px" }}>
                  <h4 style={{ margin: "0 0 5px 0", fontSize: "15px", whiteSpace: "nowrap", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}>
                    {movie.title}
                  </h4>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontSize: "13px", color: "#aaa" }}>
                    <span>{movie.release_year || "N/A"}</span>
                    <span style={{ color: "#f5c518" }}>⭐ {movie.avg_rating > 0 ? movie.avg_rating : "N/A"}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {loading && (
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "30px", color: "#9b5cff", fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "bold" }}>
            ⏳ Loading more movies...
          </div>
        )}
        
        {!hasMore && movies.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "40px", color: "#555", fontSize: "14px" }}>
            You've reached the end of the filmography.
          </div>
        )}

      </div>

      {/* 🌟 Search Modal Rendered at the Bottom */}
      <SearchModal isOpen={isSearchOpen} onClose={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)} />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/pages/GenreSelection.jsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import "../styles/genre-selection.css";

const genres = [
  { id: 1, name: "Action", icon: "⚡" },
  { id: 2, name: "Comedy", icon: "😂" },
  { id: 3, name: "Drama", icon: "🎭" },

  { id: 5, name: "Horror", icon: "👻" },
  { id: 6, name: "Romance", icon: "❤️" },
  { id: 7, name: "Sci-Fi", icon: "🚀" },
  { id: 8, name: "Adventure", icon: "🗺️" },
  { id: 9, name: "Fantasy", icon: "🧙" },
  { id: 10, name: "Mystery", icon: "🔎" },
  { id: 11, name: "Crime", icon: "🕵️" },
  { id: 12, name: "Animation", icon: "🎨" },
  { id: 13, name: "Documentary", icon: "🎥" },
  { id: 14, name: "Family", icon: "👨‍👩‍👧" },
  { id: 15, name: "Musical", icon: "🎵" },
  { id: 16, name: "War", icon: "⚔️" },
  { id: 17, name: "Western", icon: "🤠" },
  { id: 18, name: "History", icon: "🏛️" },
];

export default function GenreSelection() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [selectedGenres, setSelectedGenres] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const toggleGenre = (genreId) => {
    setSelectedGenres((current) => {
      if (current.includes(genreId)) {
        return current.filter((id) => id !== genreId);
      }
      return [...current, genreId];
    });
  };

  const handleContinue = async () => {
    if (selectedGenres.length < 3) return;

    const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
    if (!token) {
      navigate("/login");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      // 🌟 Map selected IDs to actual genre names (strings) so backend receives a list of strings
      const selectedGenreNames = genres
        .filter((genre) => selectedGenres.includes(genre.id))
        .map((genre) => genre.name);

      const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/preferences", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          genres: selectedGenreNames // 👈 Sending names array to match backend string expectation
        })
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        setError(data.error || "Failed to save genres");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      localStorage.setItem("selectedGenres", JSON.stringify(selectedGenreNames));
      navigate("/home");

    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Preference connection error:", err);
      setError("Unable to connect to server.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="genre-page">
      <div className="genre-glow genre-glow-one"></div>
      <div className="genre-glow genre-glow-two"></div>

      <div className="genre-container">
        <div className="genre-logo">
          MOVIE<span>VERSE</span>
        </div>

        <div className="genre-header">
          <div className="genre-icon">🎬</div>
          <h1>Tell us what you love</h1>
          <p>
            Choose a few genres you enjoy and we'll personalize your MovieVerse experience.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="selection-info">
          <span>Select at least 3 genres</span>
          <strong>{selectedGenres.length} selected</strong>
        </div>

        <div className="genres-grid">
          {genres.map((genre) => {
            const isSelected = selectedGenres.includes(genre.id);
            return (
              <button
                key={genre.id}
                type="button"
                className={`genre-card ${isSelected ? "selected" : ""}`}
                onClick={() => toggleGenre(genre.id)}
              >
                <span className="genre-card-icon">{genre.icon}</span>
                <span className="genre-name">{genre.name}</span>
                {isSelected && <span className="genre-check">✓</span>}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div style={{ color: "#ff4757", textAlign: "center", marginBottom: "15px", fontSize: "14px" }}>
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="genre-bottom">
          {selectedGenres.length < 3 ? (
            <p className="genre-hint">
              Select {3 - selectedGenres.length} more
              {3 - selectedGenres.length === 1 ? " genre" : " genres"}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <p className="genre-ready">
              Great! Your recommendations are ready.
            </p>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            className={`continue-button ${selectedGenres.length >= 3 ? "active" : ""}`}
            onClick={handleContinue}
            disabled={selectedGenres.length < 3 || loading}
          >
            {loading ? "Saving..." : "Continue"}
            <span>→</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/pages/MonthlyReview.jsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { getUserProfile } from "../services/homeService";
import Navbar from "../components/Navbar";
import SearchModal from "../components/SearchModal";
import "../styles/monthlyReview.css";
import CinematicLoader from "../components/CinematicLoader";

export default function MonthlyReview() {
  const [currentDate, setCurrentDate] = useState(new Date());
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSearchOpen, setIsSearchOpen] = useState(false);

  const currentUserId = localStorage.getItem("user_id");

  useEffect(() => {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    const fetchReviews = async () => {
      if (!currentUserId) {
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      setLoading(true);
      const data = await getUserProfile(currentUserId);
      if (data && data.reviews) {
        setReviews(data.reviews);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    };
    fetchReviews();
  }, [currentUserId]);

  // Calendar Logic
  const year = currentDate.getFullYear();
  const month = currentDate.getMonth();
  
  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
  const firstDayOfMonth = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay(); // 0 = Sunday
  
  const monthNames = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];

  const handlePrevMonth = () => setCurrentDate(new Date(year, month - 1, 1));
  const handleNextMonth = () => setCurrentDate(new Date(year, month + 1, 1));

  // Extract this month's reviews
  const thisMonthReviews = reviews.filter(review => {
    const rDate = new Date(review.created_at);
    return rDate.getFullYear() === year && rDate.getMonth() === month;
  });

  // Group reviews by date
  const reviewsByDate = {};
  thisMonthReviews.forEach(review => {
    const day = new Date(review.created_at).getDate();
    if (!reviewsByDate[day]) reviewsByDate[day] = [];
    reviewsByDate[day].push(review);
  });

  const getRatingColor = (rating) => {
    if (rating >= 4.5) return "#00d26a"; // Perfect
    if (rating >= 3.5) return "#00b894"; // Good
    if (rating >= 2.0) return "#fdcb6e"; // Avg
    return "#ff4757"; // Bad
  };

  if (!currentUserId) return <h1 className="error-text">Please login to see your calendar.</h1>;

  return (
    <div className="monthly-review-page">
      <Navbar onOpenSearch={() => setIsSearchOpen(true)} />
      <SearchModal isOpen={isSearchOpen} onClose={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)} />

      <main className="calendar-container">
        
        {/* HEADER CONTROLS */}
        <div className="calendar-header">
          <div className="cal-nav">
            <button className="cal-btn" onClick={handlePrevMonth}>&#8592; Prev</button>
            <h1 className="cal-title">{monthNames[month]} <span>{year}</span></h1>
            <button className="cal-btn" onClick={handleNextMonth}>Next &#8594;</button>
          </div>
          <div className="cal-stats">
            You reviewed <strong>{thisMonthReviews.length}</strong> movies this month.
          </div>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <h2 className="loading-text">Loading Calendar...</h2>
        ) : (
          <div className="calendar-grid">
            {/* Days of Week */}
            {["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"].map(d => (
              <div key={d} className="day-name">{d}</div>
            ))}

            {/* Empty boxes for offset */}
            {Array(firstDayOfMonth).fill(null).map((_, i) => (
              <div key={`empty-${i}`} className="calendar-cell empty"></div>
            ))}

            {/* Actual Days */}
            {Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }, (_, i) => i + 1).map(day => {
              const dayReviews = reviewsByDate[day] || [];
              const isToday = day === new Date().getDate() && month === new Date().getMonth() && year === new Date().getFullYear();

              return (
                <div key={day} className={`calendar-cell ${dayReviews.length > 0 ? 'has-reviews' : ''} ${isToday ? 'is-today' : ''}`}>
                  <span className="date-number">{day}</span>
                  
                  <div className="cell-reviews">
                    {dayReviews.map(review => (
                      <Link 
                        to={`/movie/${review.movie_id}`} 
                        key={review.review_id} 
                        className="movie-tag"
                        style={{ borderLeftColor: getRatingColor(review.rating) }}
                        title={`${review.title} - ${review.rating} Stars`}
                      >
                        {review.title}
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/pages/signup.jsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import PosterAnimation from "../components/PosterAnimation";
import "../styles/signup.css";

export default function Signup() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");

  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");

  // 🔥 NAYA: OTP ke liye states
  const [isOtpSent, setIsOtpSent] = useState(false);
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState("");

  const handleSignup = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");

    if (!username || !email || !password || !confirmPassword) {
      setError("Please fill in all fields");
      return;
    }
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Passwords do not match");
      return;
    }
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setError("Password must be at least 6 characters");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/register", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ username, email, password })
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        setError(data.error || "Registration failed");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      console.log("Registration successful:", data);
      
      // 🔥 NAYA: Redirect karne ki jagah OTP screen dikhao
      setSuccess("Account created! Please check your email for the OTP.");
      setIsOtpSent(true); 
      setLoading(false);

    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Signup error:", error);
      setError("Unable to connect to server. Make sure Flask is running.");
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 🔥 NAYA: OTP Verify karne ka function
  const handleVerifyOtp = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
    setLoading(true);

    if (!otp) {
      setError("Please enter the 6-digit OTP");
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/verify-otp", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: email, otp: otp })
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        setError(data.error || "Invalid OTP");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setSuccess("Email verified successfully! Redirecting to login...");
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        navigate("/login");
      }, 2000);

    } catch (error) {
      setError("Unable to connect to server.");
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="signup-page">
      <div className="signup-left">
        <PosterAnimation />
      </div>

      <div className="signup-right">
        <div className="signup-card">
          <h1>{isOtpSent ? "Verify Email" : "Create Account"}</h1>
          <p className="signup-subtitle">
            {isOtpSent 
              ? "We've sent a 6-digit code to your email." 
              : "Join MovieVerse and discover movies you'll love."}
          </p>

          {/* 🔥 NAYA: Agar OTP nahi bheja hai toh Signup form, warna OTP form */}
          {!isOtpSent ? (
            <form onSubmit={handleSignup}>
              {/* USERNAME */}
              <div className="signup-input-group">
                <label>Username</label>
                <div className="signup-input-wrapper">
                  <span className="signup-input-icon">👤</span>
                  <input type="text" placeholder="Username" value={username} onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)} />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* EMAIL */}
              <div className="signup-input-group">
                <label>Email</label>
                <div className="signup-input-wrapper">
                  <span className="signup-input-icon">✉</span>
                  <input type="email" placeholder="Email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* PASSWORD */}
              <div className="signup-input-group">
                <label>Password</label>
                <div className="signup-input-wrapper">
                  <span className="signup-input-icon">🔒</span>
                  <input type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"} placeholder="Password" value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
                  <button type="button" className="signup-eye-button" onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}>
                    {showPassword ? "◉" : "◌"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* CONFIRM PASSWORD */}
              <div className="signup-input-group">
                <label>Confirm Password</label>
                <div className="signup-input-wrapper">
                  <span className="signup-input-icon">🔒</span>
                  <input type={showConfirmPassword ? "text" : "password"} placeholder="Confirm Password" value={confirmPassword} onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)} />
                  <button type="button" className="signup-eye-button" onClick={() => setShowConfirmPassword(!showConfirmPassword)}>
                    {showConfirmPassword ? "◉" : "◌"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {error && <div className="signup-error">{error}</div>}
              {success && <div className="signup-success">{success}</div>}

              <button type="submit" className="signup-button" disabled={loading}>
                {loading ? "Creating Account..." : "Create Account"}
              </button>
            </form>
          ) : (
            /* 🔥 NAYA: OTP VERIFICATION FORM */
            <form onSubmit={handleVerifyOtp}>
              <div className="signup-input-group">
                <label>Enter 6-Digit OTP</label>
                <div className="signup-input-wrapper">
                  <span className="signup-input-icon">🔑</span>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    placeholder="e.g. 123456" 
                    value={otp} 
                    onChange={(e) => setOtp(e.target.value)} 
                    maxLength="6"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {error && <div className="signup-error">{error}</div>}
              {success && <div className="signup-success">{success}</div>}

              <button type="submit" className="signup-button" disabled={loading}>
                {loading ? "Verifying..." : "Verify & Login"}
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          <div className="login-text">
            <span>Already have an account?</span>
            <Link to="/login">Login</Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/login.css">
* {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  background: #050507;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;

}


/* =========================
   MAIN LOGIN PAGE
========================= */

.login-page {
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;

  display: flex;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 40% 50%,
      rgba(112, 38, 190, 0.12),
      transparent 45%
    ),
    #050507;
}


/* =========================
   LEFT SIDE
========================= */

.login-left {
  width: 55%;
  height: 100vh;

  position: relative;

  overflow: hidden;
}


/* =========================
   POSTER AREA
========================= */

.poster-area {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;

  position: relative;

  overflow: hidden;
}


/* Poster columns container */

.poster-columns {
  position: absolute;

  width: 120%;
  height: 125%;

  left: -8%;
  top: -12%;

  display: flex;

  gap: 18px;

  transform: rotate(-4deg);
}


/* Individual column */

.poster-column {
  width: 24%;

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

  gap: 18px;

  flex-shrink: 0;
}


/* Posters */

.movie-poster {
  width: 100%;

  aspect-ratio: 0.67;

  object-fit: cover;

  border-radius: 12px;

  display: block;

  box-shadow:
    0 0 18px rgba(120, 45, 220, 0.15);

  filter: brightness(0.62);

  flex-shrink: 0;
}


/* =========================
   ANIMATIONS
========================= */

.move-up {
  animation: moveUp 28s linear infinite;
}

.move-down {
  animation: moveDown 32s linear infinite;
}


@keyframes moveUp {

  from {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(-33.333%);
  }

}


@keyframes moveDown {

  from {
    transform: translateY(-33.333%);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

}


/* =========================
   POSTER DARK OVERLAY
========================= */

.poster-overlay {
  position: absolute;

  inset: 0;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      rgba(5, 5, 7, 0.15),
      rgba(5, 5, 7, 0.05) 45%,
      rgba(5, 5, 7, 0.75)
    );

  pointer-events: none;
}


/* Purple glow */

.poster-area::after {

  content: "";

  position: absolute;

  width: 420px;
  height: 420px;

  left: 38%;
  top: 45%;

  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

  background: rgba(123, 45, 220, 0.16);

  filter: blur(120px);

  pointer-events: none;
}


/* =========================
   MOVIEVERSE CENTER LOGO
========================= */

.movieverse-logo {

  position: absolute;

  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;

  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

  z-index: 10;

  padding: 12px 26px;

  border-radius: 10px;

  color: white;

  font-size: 27px;

  font-weight: 700;

  letter-spacing: 0.3px;

  background: rgba(10, 7, 18, 0.82);

  border: 1px solid rgba(160, 70, 255, 0.65);

  box-shadow:
    0 0 15px rgba(145, 55, 255, 0.7),
    0 0 35px rgba(145, 55, 255, 0.25);

}


/* =========================
   RIGHT SIDE
========================= */

.login-right {

  width: 47%;
  height: 100vh;

  display: flex;

  align-items: center;

  justify-content: center;

  padding: 50px;
}


/* =========================
   LOGIN CARD
========================= */

.login-card {

  width: 430px;

  padding: 40px;

  border-radius: 20px;

  background:
    rgba(20, 16, 29, 0.72);

  border: 1px solid rgba(150, 75, 230, 0.28);

  box-shadow:
    0 0 30px rgba(112, 38, 190, 0.12);

  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);

}


/* Heading */

.login-card h1 {

  color: white;

  font-size: 34px;

  margin-bottom: 8px;

}


/* Subtitle */

.login-subtitle {

  color: #aaa4b5;

  font-size: 15px;

  margin-bottom: 32px;

}


/* =========================
   INPUT
========================= */

.input-group {

  margin-bottom: 20px;

}


.input-group label {

  display: block;

  color: #ddd7e5;

  font-size: 14px;

  margin-bottom: 8px;

}


.input-wrapper {

  height: 52px;

  display: flex;

  align-items: center;

  position: relative;

  border-radius: 10px;

  border: 1px solid rgba(170, 160, 185, 0.18);

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);

}


.input-icon {

  margin-left: 16px;

  margin-right: 10px;

  color: #8d8797;

  font-size: 16px;

}


.input-wrapper input {

  width: 100%;

  height: 100%;

  border: none;

  outline: none;

  background: transparent;

  color: white;

  font-size: 15px;

  padding-right: 45px;

}


.input-wrapper input::placeholder {

  color: #777180;

}


/* Password eye */

.eye-button {

  position: absolute;

  right: 14px;

  top: 50%;

  transform: translateY(-50%);

  border: none;

  background: transparent;

  color: #aaa4b5;

  cursor: pointer;

  font-size: 17px;

}


/* =========================
   LOGIN BUTTON
========================= */

.login-button {

  width: 100%;

  height: 52px;

  margin-top: 8px;

  border: none;

  border-radius: 10px;

  color: white;

  font-size: 16px;

  font-weight: 600;

  cursor: pointer;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      #7624df,
      #9b4df5
    );

  box-shadow:
    0 8px 25px rgba(130, 40, 230, 0.25);

  transition: 0.25s ease;

}


.login-button:hover {

  transform: translateY(-2px);

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 30px rgba(140, 45, 240, 0.4);

}


/* =========================
   SIGN UP
========================= */

.signup-text {

  margin-top: 24px;

  text-align: center;

  font-size: 14px;

  color: #8f8999;

}


.signup-text a {

  margin-left: 5px;

  color: #a45cff;

  font-weight: 600;

  text-decoration: none;

}


.signup-text a:hover {

  color: #c08cff;

  text-decoration: underline;

}


/* =========================
   RESPONSIVE
========================= */

@media (max-width: 900px) {

  .login-left {
    width: 55%;
  }

  .login-right {
    width: 55%;
    padding: 25px;
  }

  .login-card {
    width: 100%;
  }

}


@media (max-width: 700px) {

  body {
    overflow: auto;
  }

  .login-page {
    height: auto;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  .login-left {
    display: none;
  }

  .login-right {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

    .login-error {
    color: #ff6b8a;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-top: -8px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    }

    .login-button:disabled {
    opacity: 0.7;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/monthlyReview.css">
.monthly-review-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #050507;
  color: #fff;
  /* padding-top: px; Navbar space */
}

.calendar-container {

/* HEADER NAV */

  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);

}

.cal-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 30px;
}

.cal-title {
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.cal-title span {
  color: #9b5cff;
}

.cal-btn {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  color: #fff;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
}
.cal-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.2);
  border-color: #9b5cff;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.cal-stats {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #aaa;
}
.cal-stats strong {
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 20px;
}

/* GRID LAYOUT */
.calendar-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}

.day-name {
  text-align: right;
  padding-right: 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #666;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

/* CALENDAR CELLS */
.calendar-cell {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border-radius: 12px;
  min-height: 140px;
  padding: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.calendar-cell.empty {
  background: transparent;
  border-color: transparent;
}

/* THE HOVER MAGIC */
.calendar-cell:not(.empty):hover {
  background: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.05);
  border-color: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.4);
  transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.02);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.15);
  z-index: 10;
}

.date-number {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #444;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  align-self: flex-end;
  transition: color 0.3s;
}

.calendar-cell:hover .date-number {
  color: #9b5cff;
}

.is-today {
  border-color: rgba(29, 185, 84, 0.3);
  background: rgba(29, 185, 84, 0.03);
}
.is-today .date-number {
  color: #1db954;
}

/* MOVIE TAGS */
.cell-reviews {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.movie-tag {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-left: 3px solid #777; /* Default, gets overridden in JSX */
  color: #ddd;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.movie-tag:hover {
  transform: translateX(4px);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  color: #fff;
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/posterAnimation.css">
.poster-area {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #050507;
}


/* =========================
   POSTER COLUMNS
========================= */

.poster-columns {
  position: absolute;

  top: -20%;
  left: -8%;

  width: 116%;
  height: 40%;

  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;

  transform: rotate(-6deg) scale(1.08);
}


/* =========================
   INDIVIDUAL COLUMN
========================= */

.poster-column {
  flex: 1;

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

  gap: 14px;

  min-width: 0;
}


/* =========================
   MOVIE POSTERS
========================= */

.movie-poster {
  width: 100%;

  aspect-ratio: 2 / 3;

  object-fit: cover;

  display: block;

  border-radius: 7px;

  opacity: 1;

  flex-shrink: 0;

  user-select: none;
  pointer-events: none;
}


/* =========================
   MOVEMENT
========================= */

.move-up {
  animation: moveUp 12s linear infinite;
}

.move-down {
  animation: moveDown 15s linear infinite;
}


/* =========================
   UP ANIMATION
========================= */

@keyframes moveUp {

  from {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(-25%);
  }

}


/* =========================
   DOWN ANIMATION
========================= */

@keyframes moveDown {

  from {
    transform: translateY(-25%);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

}


/* =========================
   DARK OVERLAY
========================= */

.poster-overlay {

  position: absolute;

  inset: 0;

  z-index: 5;

  pointer-events: none;

  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(5, 5, 7, 0.20) 0%,
    rgba(5, 5, 7, 0.35) 45%,
    rgba(5, 5, 7, 0.96) 100%
  );

}


/* =========================
   MOVIEVERSE LOGO
========================= */

.movieverse-logo {

  position: absolute;

  z-index: 10;

  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;

  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

  color: white;

  font-size: 34px;

  font-weight: 700;

  letter-spacing: 2px;

  text-shadow:
    0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35),
    0 0 25px rgba(140, 80, 255, 0.45);

  white-space: nowrap;

}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/profile.css">
.profile-page-wrapper {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background-color: #050507;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
}

.loading-text, .error-text {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 15%;
  color: #fff;
}

/* 1. Parent container ko flex-start karna zaroori hai, taaki sidebar stretch na ho */
.profile-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 30px;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 100px auto;
  padding: 0 20px;
  align-items: flex-start; /* 🌟 SABSE ZAROORI: Iske bina sticky kaam nahi karega */
}

/* 2. Sidebar ko Sticky banana hai */
.profile-sidebar {
  flex: 0 0 300px; /* Sidebar ki width fix rakhi hai */
  position: -webkit-sticky; /* Safari support ke liye */
  position: sticky; /* 🌟 Yeh profile card ko lock kar dega */
  top: 100px; /* 🌟 Upar se gap chhodne ke liye (Navbar ke niche set karne ke liye isko apne hisaab se kam/zyada kar lena, jaise 80px ya 120px) */
}

.profile-card {
  background: #111111;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 30px 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}

.pc-avatar {
  width: 130px;
  height: 130px;
  background: #3b4255;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 40px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  color: #fff;
}

.pc-fullname {
  font-size: 22px;
  margin: 0 0 5px 0;
}

.pc-username {
  color: #888;
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.pc-stats-row {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: space-around;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.pc-stat-box {
  text-align: center;
}
.pc-stat-box h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; }
.pc-stat-box p { margin: 5px 0 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: #888; line-height: 1.4; }

.pc-footer-info {
  width: 100%;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #888;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}
.pc-footer-info p { margin: 5px 0; }

.btn-edit-profile {
  width: 100%;
  background: #2a2a2a;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: 0.2s;
}
.btn-edit-profile:hover { background: #333; }

/* RIGHT AREA (Main Content) */
/* Main area normal rahega */
.profile-main-area {
  flex: 1;
}

/* TABS */
.profile-tabs-container {
  display: flex;
  background: #111111;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 5px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.ptab {
  flex: 1;
  background: transparent;
  color: #888;
  border: none;
  padding: 12px;
  font-size: 15px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.ptab.active {
  background: #222222;
  color: #fff;
}

/* FILTERS */
.profile-filters {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.pfilter-btn {
  background: transparent;
  color: #888;
  border: none;
  padding: 6px 15px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: 0.2s;
}
.pfilter-btn:hover { color: #fff; }
.pfilter-btn.active {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  color: #fff;
}

/* REVIEWS LIST */
.profile-reviews-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 30px;
}

.pr-list-card {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  padding-bottom: 25px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

.pr-poster-link { flex-shrink: 0; }
.pr-list-poster {
  width: 110px;
  height: 160px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.pr-list-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
}

.pr-list-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.pr-title {
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.pr-badge {
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.badge-perfect { background: #96248d; color: #000; } 
.badge-good { background: #00b894; color: #fff; } 
.badge-avg { background: #fdcb6e; color: #000; } 
.badge-bad { background: #ff4757; color: #fff; } 

.pr-meta {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #888;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}
.pr-star-display { color: #f5c518; margin-left: 5px; }

.pr-review-text {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: #ddd;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0 0 15px 0;
}

.pr-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: auto;
}
.pr-action-btn {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #888;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.pr-action-btn:hover { color: #fff; }

.no-reviews-msg {
  color: #888;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 40px;
}

/* ============================
   🌟 NAYA: ANALYTICS DASHBOARD CSS
=============================== */
.stat-cards-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.stat-card {
  background: #111111;
  padding: 25px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

.stat-card h4 { 
  color: #888; 
  margin: 0 0 10px 0; 
  font-size: 14px; 
  text-transform: uppercase; 
}

.stat-card h2 { 
  margin: 0; 
  font-size: 36px; 
  font-weight: 800; 
}

.stat-card span { 
  font-size: 16px; 
  color: #aaa; 
  font-weight: normal; 
}

.charts-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
}

.chart-box {
  background: #111111;
  padding: 25px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

.chart-box h3 { 
  margin: 0 0 20px 0; 
  font-size: 18px; 
}

.chart-wrapper { 
  width: 100%; 
  display: flex; 
  justify-content: center; 
}

.chart-legend {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 15px;
  margin-top: 15px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #ccc;
}

.chart-legend .dot {
  display: inline-block; 
  width: 10px; 
  height: 10px; 
  border-radius: 50%; 
  margin-right: 5px;
}

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/searchModal.css">
.search-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85); 
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  z-index: 9999999;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  padding-top: 100px;
  animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

.search-modal-content {
  background: #111114;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 750px; /* Thoda aur chouda kar diya grid ke liye */
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-shadow: 0 25px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.search-input-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 15px 20px;
  background: #1a1a20;
}

.search-icon-inside {
  margin-right: 15px;
}

.search-input-wrapper input {
  flex: 1;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 20px;
  outline: none;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.search-input-wrapper input::placeholder {
  color: #666;
}

.close-search-btn {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border: none;
  color: #aaa;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.close-search-btn:hover {
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

/* ============================
   TABS STYLING (MOVIES / USERS)
=============================== */
.search-tabs {
  display: flex;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  background: #16161b;
}

.s-tab {
  flex: 1;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: #888;
  padding: 14px 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.s-tab:hover {
  color: #ddd;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.s-tab.active {
  color: #9b5cff;
  border-bottom-color: #9b5cff;
}

/* ============================
   SEARCH HISTORY STYLING
=============================== */
.search-history-section {
  padding: 15px 20px;
}

.sh-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.sh-header h4 {
  color: #777;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin: 0;
}

.clear-hist-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: #ff4757;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.clear-hist-btn:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.history-item {
  color: #ccc;
  padding: 10px 15px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  transition: 0.2s;
}
.history-item:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  color: #fff;
}

/* ============================
   RESULTS AREA (GRID POSTERS)
=============================== */
.search-results-container {
  max-height: 60vh; 
  overflow-y: auto; 
  padding: 15px 20px;
}

.search-results-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
}
.search-results-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #444;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.search-msg {
  text-align: center;
  color: #888;
  padding: 30px;
  font-size: 16px;
}

/* 🌟 NAYA: GRID LAYOUT FOR POSTERS */

  display: grid;

  gap: 20px;

}

.search-result-card {

}

.search-result-card:hover {

}

.src-poster-wrapper {

/* User Card Specific Styling */
.src-avatar {

.sm-tabs {

}

.sm-tab-btn {

  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/watchlist.css">
.watchlist-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #050507;
  color: #fff;
  /* padding-top: px; */
}

.wl-container {
  max-width: 1400px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 40px 4%;
}

.wl-header h1 {
  font-size: 38px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0 0 10px 0;
}

.wl-header p {
  color: #888;
  font-size: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.wl-filters {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  padding-bottom: 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.wl-label {
  color: #666;
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-right: 10px;
}

.wl-select {
  background: transparent;
  color: #fff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.wl-select option {
  background: #111;
}

/* THE GRID */
.wl-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 25px;
}

.wl-card {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: block;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  aspect-ratio: 2 / 3;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.wl-poster {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease, filter 0.4s ease;
}

/* HOVER EFFECT */
.wl-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02);
  border-color: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.25);
  z-index: 10;
}

.wl-card:hover .wl-poster {
  transform: scale(1.08);
  filter: blur(2px) brightness(0.4);
}

/* OVERLAY UI */
.wl-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  opacity: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(5,5,7,0.95) 0%, rgba(5,5,7,0.5) 100%);
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

.wl-card:hover .wl-overlay {
  opacity: 1;
}

.wl-title {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 5px 0;
  color: #fff;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
}

.wl-stars {
  color: #f5c518;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}
.wl-rating-num {
  color: #ccc;
  margin-left: 5px;
}

.wl-synopsis {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #ddd;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0;
}

.wl-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.wl-btn-watched, .wl-btn-remove {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  transition: 0.2s;
}

.wl-btn-watched {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  color: #fff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
}
.wl-btn-watched:hover { background: #1db954; border-color: #1db954; color: #000; }

.wl-btn-remove {
  background: transparent;
  color: #888;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}
.wl-btn-remove:hover { background: rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.15); border-color: #ff4757; color: #ff4757; }

/* Empty state */
.wl-empty {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 100px 20px;
}
.btn-explore {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 12px 30px;
  background: #9b5cff;
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-radius: 25px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
