                        fontSize: "14px", cursor: "pointer", padding: "4px", transition: "0.2s"
                      }}
                      onMouseEnter={(e) => e.target.style.color = "#ff4757"}
                      onMouseLeave={(e) => e.target.style.color = "#444"}
                      title="Delete"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* 👤 PROFILE DROPDOWN */}
        {userId && (
          <div style={{ position: "relative" }} ref={dropdownRef}>
            <div 
              onClick={() => {
                setShowDropdown(!showDropdown);
                setShowNotifDropdown(false);
                setShowInbox(false); // Close Inbox 
              }}
              className="nav-item"
            >
              <div className="profile-circle">
                {username ? username.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : "U"}
              </div>
              <span className="nav-text">Profile</span>
            </div>

            {showDropdown && (
              <div className="custom-dropdown" style={{ width: "200px" }}>
                <div style={{ padding: "12px 16px", borderBottom: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)", fontSize: "13px", color: "#888" }}>
                  Signed in as <strong style={{ color: "#fff" }}>@{username || "user"}</strong>
                </div>

                <Link 
                  to={`/profile/${userId}`}
                  onClick={() => setShowDropdown(false)}
                  className="dropdown-item"
                >
                  👤 My Profile
                </Link>

                <Link 
                  to={`/monthly-review`}
                  onClick={() => setShowDropdown(false)}
                  className="dropdown-item"
                >
                  📊 Monthly Analytics
                </Link>

                <div className="dropdown-divider"></div>

                <button onClick={handleLogout} className="dropdown-item logout-btn">
                  🚪 Log Out
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/pages/Home.jsx">
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import MovieRow from "../components/MovieRow";
import SearchModal from "../components/SearchModal"; 
import Navbar from "../components/Navbar";
import CinematicLoader from "../components/CinematicLoader";
import "../styles/home.css";

export default function Home() {
  const [homeData, setHomeData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [featuredIndex, setFeaturedIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isSearchModalOpen, setIsSearchModalOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setIsSearchModalOpen(true);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchHomeData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true); 
        const res = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/home", {
          method: "GET",
          cache: "no-store",
          headers: {
            "Authorization": `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("token")}`,
            "Pragma": "no-cache",
            "Cache-Control": "no-cache"
          }
        });
        
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          setHomeData(data);
          
          // 🚀 JAISE HI HOME PAGE LOAD HO, CHUP-CHAAP BACKGROUND MEIN MODEL LOAD KAR DO
          fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/warmup")
            .then(() => console.log("🔥 ML Models Warm-up Complete!"))
            .catch((err) => console.log("Warmup failed", err));

        } else {
          // 🔥 SMART FIX: Agar Token expire ho gaya (401), seedha login par bhejo!
          if (res.status === 401) {
            console.warn("Token expired! Redirecting to login...");
            localStorage.removeItem("token"); // Purana kachra saaf
            window.location.href = "/login"; // Seedha login page par dhakka
            return;
          }
          
          const errData = await res.json();
          setError(errData.error || "Failed to fetch data");
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Home load error:", error);
        setError("Network Error. Is Flask running?");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchHomeData();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (homeData?.featured_movies?.length > 0) {
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        setFeaturedIndex((prevIndex) => 
          (prevIndex + 1) % homeData.featured_movies.length
        );
      }, 3500); 
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }
  }, [homeData]);

  if (loading) return <CinematicLoader />;
  if (error) return <div className="home-error">Failed to load home: {error}</div>;

  const featured = homeData?.featured_movies ? homeData.featured_movies[featuredIndex] : null;

  return (
    <div className="home-page">
      <Navbar onOpenSearch={() => setIsSearchModalOpen(true)} />
      <SearchModal isOpen={isSearchModalOpen} onClose={() => setIsSearchModalOpen(false)} />

      {featured && (
        <div className="hero-banner">
          <div className="hero-bg fade-bg" style={{ backgroundImage: `url(${featured.poster_url})` }}></div>
          <div className="hero-overlay"></div>
          <div className="hero-container">
            <div className="hero-content" key={featured.movie_id}>
              <div className="hero-badge">🔥 Latest Release</div>
              <h1 className="hero-title">{featured.title}</h1>
              <div className="hero-meta">
                <span className="rating">⭐ {featured.avg_rating || "N/A"}</span>
                <span className="year">{featured.release_year || "Unknown"}</span>
                <span className="quality">4K</span>
              </div>
              <p className="hero-overview">
                {featured.overview 
                  ? (featured.overview.length > 200 ? featured.overview.substring(0, 200) + "..." : featured.overview) 
                  : "No description available for this movie."}
              </p>
              <div className="hero-actions">
                <Link to={`/movie/${featured.movie_id}`} className="btn-play" style={{ textDecoration: 'none', display: 'inline-block' }}>
                  <span className="play-icon">▶</span> View Details
                </Link>
                <button className="btn-watchlist"><span>+</span> Add to Watchlist</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Link to={`/movie/${featured.movie_id}`} className="hero-poster-box" key={`poster-${featured.movie_id}`}>
              <img src={featured.poster_url} alt={featured.title} className="hero-poster-img" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <main className="home-content">
        {homeData?.because_you_love?.length > 0 && homeData?.dynamic_genre_name && (
          <MovieRow 
            title={`BECAUSE YOU LOVE ${homeData.dynamic_genre_name.toUpperCase()}`} 
            movies={homeData.because_you_love} 
            seeMoreLink={`/explore?genre=${homeData.dynamic_genre_name}`}
          />
        )}

        <MovieRow title="NEW RELEASES" movies={homeData?.new_releases || []} seeMoreLink="/explore?sort_by=Newest" />
        
        {homeData?.hidden_gems?.length > 0 && (
          <MovieRow title="💎 HIDDEN GEMS" movies={homeData.hidden_gems} seeMoreLink="/explore?sort_by=Top Rated" />
        )}

        <MovieRow title="RECOMMENDED FOR YOU" movies={homeData?.recommended_for_you || []} seeMoreLink="/explore" />
        
        <MovieRow title="ALL TIME TOP RATED" movies={homeData?.top_rated || []} seeMoreLink="/explore?sort_by=Top Rated" />
        
        {homeData?.genre_sections?.map((section) => (
          <MovieRow 
            key={section.genre} 
            title={`TOP IN ${(section.genre || "").toUpperCase()}`} 
            movies={section.movies || []} 
            seeMoreLink={`/explore?genre=${section.genre}`} 
          />
        ))}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/pages/login.jsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import PosterAnimation from "../components/PosterAnimation";
import "../styles/login.css";

export default function Login() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState(""); // 🌟 NAYA: Login success msg ke liye

  // 🔥 NAYA: Forgot Password States
  const [showForgotModal, setShowForgotModal] = useState(false);
  const [forgotStep, setForgotStep] = useState(1); // 1 = Email, 2 = OTP + New Password
  const [forgotEmail, setForgotEmail] = useState("");
  const [forgotOtp, setForgotOtp] = useState("");
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState("");
  const [forgotLoading, setForgotLoading] = useState(false);
  const [forgotError, setForgotError] = useState("");
  const [forgotSuccess, setForgotSuccess] = useState("");

  const handleLogin = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setSuccessMsg("");

    if (!email || !password) {
      setError("Please enter email and password");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/login", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        // 🔥 Agar is_verified false hai toh backend 403 bhejega jo yahan error mein aayega
        setError(data.error || "Login failed");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      localStorage.setItem("token", data.token);
      localStorage.setItem("user_id", data.user.user_id);
      localStorage.setItem("username", data.user.username);
      localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(data.user));

      if (data.has_genres) {
        navigate("/home"); 
      } else {
        navigate("/genres"); 
      }

    } catch (error) {
      setError("Unable to connect to server. Make sure Flask is running.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 🔥 NAYA: Step 1 - Send OTP for Forgot Password
  const handleForgotPassword = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setForgotError(""); setForgotSuccess(""); setForgotLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/forgot-password", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: forgotEmail })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setForgotError(data.error || "Failed to send OTP");
        return;
      }
      setForgotSuccess("OTP sent to your email!");
      setForgotStep(2); // Move to Step 2 (Enter OTP)
    } catch (err) {
      setForgotError("Server connection error.");
    } finally {
      setForgotLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 🔥 NAYA: Step 2 - Verify OTP and Reset Password
  const handleResetPassword = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setForgotError(""); setForgotSuccess(""); setForgotLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/reset-password-otp", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: forgotEmail, otp: forgotOtp, new_password: newPassword })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setForgotError(data.error || "Invalid OTP or request.");
        return;
      }
      // Reset successful! Close modal and show success on login screen
      setShowForgotModal(false);
      setForgotStep(1);
      setForgotEmail(""); setForgotOtp(""); setNewPassword("");
      setSuccessMsg("Password reset successfully! Please log in with your new password.");
    } catch (err) {
      setForgotError("Server connection error.");
    } finally {
      setForgotLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="login-page">
      <div className="login-left">
        <PosterAnimation />
      </div>

      <div className="login-right">
        <div className="login-card">
          <h1>Welcome Back</h1>
          <p className="login-subtitle">Discover movies you'll love.</p>

          <form onSubmit={handleLogin}>
            <div className="input-group">
              <label>Email</label>
              <div className="input-wrapper">
                <span className="input-icon">✉</span>
                <input type="email" placeholder="Email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="input-group">
              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                <label>Password</label>
                {/* 🔥 NAYA: Forgot Password Link */}
                <span 
                  style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "#9b5cff", cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: "600" }} 
                  onClick={() => setShowForgotModal(true)}
                >
                  Forgot password?
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="input-wrapper">
                <span className="input-icon">🔒</span>
                <input type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"} placeholder="Password" value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
                <button type="button" className="eye-button" onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}>
                  {showPassword ? "◉" : "◌"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {error && <div className="login-error">{error}</div>}
            {successMsg && <div className="login-success" style={{ color: "#00e676", fontSize: "14px", marginBottom: "15px", textAlign: "center" }}>{successMsg}</div>}

            <button type="submit" className="login-button" disabled={loading}>
              {loading ? "Logging in..." : "Login"}
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="signup-text">
            <span>Don't have an account?</span>
            <Link to="/signup">Sign Up</Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 🔥 NAYA: FORGOT PASSWORD MODAL */}
      {showForgotModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" style={{ position: "fixed", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", zIndex: 1000 }}>
          <div className="modal-content" style={{ background: "#0f0f13", padding: "30px", borderRadius: "12px", width: "90%", maxWidth: "400px", border: "1px solid rgba(155,92,255,0.3)" }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: "20px" }}>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: "20px", margin: 0 }}>Reset Password</h2>
              <button onClick={() => { setShowForgotModal(false); setForgotStep(1); }} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", color: "#888", fontSize: "20px", cursor: "pointer" }}>✕</button>
            </div>

            {forgotStep === 1 ? (
              <form onSubmit={handleForgotPassword}>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#aaa", marginBottom: "20px" }}>Enter your registered email address and we'll send you a 6-digit OTP to reset your password.</p>
                <div className="input-group">
                  <div className="input-wrapper">
                    <span className="input-icon">✉</span>
                    <input type="email" placeholder="Enter your email" required value={forgotEmail} onChange={(e) => setForgotEmail(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                {forgotError && <div className="login-error">{forgotError}</div>}
                {forgotSuccess && <div className="login-success" style={{ color: "#00e676", fontSize: "14px", marginTop: "10px" }}>{forgotSuccess}</div>}
                <button type="submit" className="login-button" style={{ marginTop: "15px" }} disabled={forgotLoading}>
                  {forgotLoading ? "Sending..." : "Send OTP"}
                </button>
              </form>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={handleResetPassword}>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#aaa", marginBottom: "20px" }}>Enter the OTP sent to <b>{forgotEmail}</b> and create a new password.</p>
                <div className="input-group">
                  <div className="input-wrapper">
                    <span className="input-icon">🔑</span>
                    <input type="text" placeholder="6-digit OTP" required maxLength="6" value={forgotOtp} onChange={(e) => setForgotOtp(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="input-group" style={{ marginTop: "15px" }}>
                  <div className="input-wrapper">
                    <span className="input-icon">🔒</span>
                    <input type="password" placeholder="New Password" required minLength="6" value={newPassword} onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                {forgotError && <div className="login-error">{forgotError}</div>}
                <button type="submit" className="login-button" style={{ marginTop: "15px" }} disabled={forgotLoading}>
                  {forgotLoading ? "Resetting..." : "Reset Password"}
                </button>
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/pages/profile.jsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useParams, Link } from "react-router-dom";
import SearchModal from "../components/SearchModal";
import Navbar from "../components/Navbar";
import { 
  getUserProfile, 
  getUserAnalytics, 
  getUserCollections, 
  createCollection, 
  getCollectionDetails, 
  toggleFollowUser, 
  getUserFollowStats,
  getUserReviews,
  getFollowersList, 
  getFollowingList
} from "../services/homeService";
import { PieChart, Pie, Cell, BarChart, Bar, XAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer } from "recharts";
import CinematicLoader from "../components/CinematicLoader";
import "../styles/profile.css"; 

export default function Profile() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const [profileData, setProfileData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const [analyticsData, setAnalyticsData] = useState({
    total_hours: 0,
    movies_this_year: 0,
    avg_rating: 0,
    top_genres: [],
    monthly_activity: []
  });
  
  const [collections, setCollections] = useState([]);
  const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState("");
  const [newDesc, setNewDesc] = useState("");
  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);

  // Collection Detail Modal States
  const [selectedCollection, setSelectedCollection] = useState(null);
  const [collectionMovies, setCollectionMovies] = useState([]);
  const [isColDetailOpen, setIsColDetailOpen] = useState(false);

  // Edit Profile States (Username & Bio)
  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = useState(false);
  const [editUsername, setEditUsername] = useState("");
  const [editBio, setEditBio] = useState("");

  // Follow & Stats States
  const loggedInUserId = parseInt(localStorage.getItem("user_id"));
  const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
  const isMyProfile = loggedInUserId === parseInt(id);  
  const [isFollowing, setIsFollowing] = useState(false);
  const [followStats, setFollowStats] = useState({ followers_count: 0, following_count: 0 });

  const COLORS = ["#9b5cff", "#1db954", "#f5c518", "#ff4757"];
  
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("reviews");
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState("All");
  const [isSearchOpen, setIsSearchOpen] = useState(false);

  const [showFollowModal, setShowFollowModal] = useState(false);
  const [followModalType, setFollowModalType] = useState(""); 
  const [followListData, setFollowListData] = useState([]);

  const [revealedSpoilers, setRevealedSpoilers] = useState({});

  const handleOpenFollowModal = async (type) => {
    setFollowModalType(type);
    setShowFollowModal(true);
    setFollowListData([]); 

    if (type === "followers") {
      const data = await getFollowersList(id);
      setFollowListData(data);
    } else {
      const data = await getFollowingList(id);
      setFollowListData(data);
    }
  };
  
  useEffect(() => {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    const fetchData = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      const [pData, aData, cData, sData, rData] = await Promise.all([
        getUserProfile(id),
        getUserAnalytics(id),
        getUserCollections(id),
        getUserFollowStats(id),
        getUserReviews(id)
      ]);
      
      setProfileData({
        ...(pData || {}),
        reviews: rData || []
      });

      if (aData) setAnalyticsData(aData);
      if (cData) setCollections(cData);
      if (sData) setFollowStats(sData);
      setLoading(false);
    };
    fetchData();
  }, [id]);

  const getInitials = (name) => {
    if (!name) return "";
    return name.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  };

  const getFilteredReviews = () => {
    if (!profileData || !profileData.reviews) return [];
    return profileData.reviews.filter(review => {
      const r = review.rating || 0;
      if (activeFilter === "All") return true;
      if (activeFilter === "0-1 Star") return r >= 0 && r <= 1;
      if (activeFilter === "1-3 Stars") return r > 1 && r <= 3;
      if (activeFilter === "3-4 Stars") return r > 3 && r <= 4;
      if (activeFilter === "4-5 Stars") return r > 4 && r <= 5;
      return true;
    });
  };

  const getRatingBadge = (rating) => {
    if (rating >= 4.5) return { text: "Perfection", class: "badge-perfect" };
    if (rating >= 3.5) return { text: "Go For It", class: "badge-good" };
    if (rating >= 2) return { text: "Timepass", class: "badge-avg" };
    return { text: "Skip", class: "badge-bad" };
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = () => {
    setEditUsername(profileData.user.username);
    setEditBio(profileData.user.bio || "");
    setShowEditModal(true);
  };

  const handleSaveProfile = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); 
    try {
      const res = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/user/edit", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ 
          user_id: id, 
          username: editUsername,
          bio: editBio 
        })
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        setProfileData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          user: { ...prev.user, bio: editBio, username: editUsername } 
        }));
        alert("Profile saved successfully! 🎉");
        setShowEditModal(false);
      } else {
        const errData = await res.json();
        alert(`Backend Error: ${errData.error || 'Failed to save profile'}`);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Save profile crash:", error);
      alert("Code crash ho gaya! Check console for errors.");
    }
  };

  const handleCreateCollection = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newTitle.trim()) return;
    const success = await createCollection(newTitle, newDesc);
    if (success) {
      setNewTitle("");
      setNewDesc("");
      setShowCreateModal(false);
      const data = await getUserCollections(id);
      setCollections(data);
    }
  };

  const handleCardClick = async (colId) => {
    const data = await getCollectionDetails(colId);
    if (data) {
      setSelectedCollection(data.collection);
      setCollectionMovies(data.movies);
      setIsColDetailOpen(true);
    }
  };

  const handleFollowToggle = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:5000/users/${id}/follow`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}` // 🔥 Token bhej rahe hain
        }
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setIsFollowing(data.is_following);
        
        // Follow dabane ke baad stats refresh karne ke liye
        const sData = await getUserFollowStats(id);
        setFollowStats(sData);
      } else {
        console.error("Failed to follow user");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Follow trigger error:", err);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <CinematicLoader />;
  if (!profileData || !profileData.user) return <h1 className="error-text">❌ User Not Found</h1>;

  const filteredReviews = getFilteredReviews();

  return (
    <div className="profile-page-wrapper">
      <Navbar onOpenSearch={() => setIsSearchOpen(true)} />

      <div className="profile-layout">
        <aside className="profile-sidebar">
          <div className="profile-card">
            <div className="pc-avatar">{getInitials(profileData.user.username)}</div>
            <h2 className="pc-fullname">{profileData.user.username}</h2>
            <span className="pc-username">@{profileData.user.username.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, '_')}</span>
            
            <div className="pc-stats-row">
              <div className="pc-stat-box">
                <h3>{profileData.reviews?.length || 0}</h3>
                <p>Reviews<br/>Posted</p>
              </div>
              <div className="pc-stat-box">
                <h3>{collections.length}</h3>
                <p>Public<br/>Collections</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="pc-footer-info">
              <p style={{ display: "flex", gap: "10px", justifyContent: "center" }}>
                👥 
                <span 
                  onClick={() => handleOpenFollowModal("followers")} 
                  style={{ cursor: "pointer", color: "#9b5cff", fontWeight: "600" }}
                >
                  {followStats.followers_count} Followers
                </span> 
                • 
                <span 
                  onClick={() => handleOpenFollowModal("following")} 
                  style={{ cursor: "pointer", color: "#9b5cff", fontWeight: "600" }}
                >
                  {followStats.following_count} Following
                </span>
              </p>
              {profileData.user.bio ? (
                <p style={{ marginTop: "15px", fontSize: "14px", fontStyle: "italic", color: "#ddd", padding: "0 10px", lineHeight: "1.4" }}>
                  "{profileData.user.bio}"
                </p>
              ) : (
                <p style={{ marginTop: "15px", fontSize: "13px", color: "#888" }}>
                  No bio added yet.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {isMyProfile ? (
              <button className="btn-edit-profile" onClick={handleOpenEdit}>Edit Profile</button>
            ) : (
              <button 
                className="btn-edit-profile" 
                onClick={handleFollowToggle}
                style={{
                  background: isFollowing ? "transparent" : "#9b5cff",
                  color: "#fff",
                  border: isFollowing ? "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)" : "none",
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  cursor: "pointer"
                }}
              >
                {isFollowing ? "Following" : "Follow"}
              </button>
            )}
            
          </div>
        </aside>

        <main className="profile-main-area">
          <div className="profile-tabs-container">
            <button 
              className={`ptab ${activeTab === "reviews" ? "active" : ""}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("reviews")}
            >
              📝 Reviews
            </button>
            <button 
              className={`ptab ${activeTab === "collections" ? "active" : ""}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("collections")}
            >
              📁 Collections
            </button>
            <button 
              className={`ptab ${activeTab === "analytics" ? "active" : ""}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("analytics")}
            >
              📊 Analytics
            </button>
          </div>

          {activeTab === "reviews" && (
            <>
              <div className="profile-filters">
                {["All", "0-1 Star", "1-3 Stars", "3-4 Stars", "4-5 Stars"].map(filter => (
                  <button 
                    key={filter}
                    className={`pfilter-btn ${activeFilter === filter ? "active" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => setActiveFilter(filter)}
                  >
                    {filter}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="profile-reviews-list">
                {filteredReviews.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="no-reviews-msg">No reviews found for this filter.</p>
                ) : (
                  filteredReviews.map((review) => {
                    const badge = getRatingBadge(review.rating);
                    return (
                      <div key={review.review_id} className="pr-list-card">
                        <Link to={`/movie/${review.movie_id}`} className="pr-poster-link">
                          <img src={review.poster_url} alt={review.title} className="pr-list-poster" />
                        </Link>
                        
                        <div className="pr-list-content">
                          <div className="pr-list-header">
                            <Link to={`/movie/${review.movie_id}`} className="pr-title">{review.movie_title || review.title}</Link>
                            <span className={`pr-badge ${badge.class}`}>{badge.text}</span>
                          </div>
                          
                          <div className="pr-meta">
                            Movie • {review.release_year || "2024"} • 
                            <span className="pr-star-display">
                              {" ★".repeat(Math.floor(review.rating || 0))}
                              {(review.rating || 0) % 1 !== 0 ? " ½" : ""}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          
                          {/* 🌟 Profile par Spoiler Blur Logic */}
                          <div style={{ position: 'relative', marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                            <p 
                              className="pr-review-text" 
                              onClick={() => {
                                if (review.is_spoiler && !revealedSpoilers[review.review_id]) {
                                  setRevealedSpoilers(prev => ({ ...prev, [review.review_id]: true }));
                                }
                              }}
                              style={{
                                filter: review.is_spoiler && !revealedSpoilers[review.review_id] ? "blur(5px)" : "none",
                                cursor: review.is_spoiler && !revealedSpoilers[review.review_id] ? "pointer" : "text",
                                userSelect: review.is_spoiler && !revealedSpoilers[review.review_id] ? "none" : "auto",
                                transition: "filter 0.3s ease",
                                margin: 0
                              }}
                            >
                              {review.review_text}
                            </p>
                            
                            {review.is_spoiler && !revealedSpoilers[review.review_id] && (
                              <div 
                                onClick={() => setRevealedSpoilers(prev => ({ ...prev, [review.review_id]: true }))}
                                style={{ position: 'absolute', top: '50%', left: '0', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)', padding: '4px 12px', borderRadius: '4px', color: '#ff4d4d', fontSize: '13px', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 'bold', border: '1px solid #ff4d4d' }}
                              >
                                ⚠️ Contains Spoilers. Click to reveal.
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          
                          <div className="pr-actions" style={{ display: "flex", gap: "15px", marginTop: "10px" }}>
                            <span className="pr-action-btn">❤️ {review.likes || 0}</span>
                            <span className="pr-action-btn">💬 {review.comment_count || 0}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {activeTab === "collections" && (
            <div className="collections-container">
              <div className="col-top-header" style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: "20px" }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "20px" }}>My Custom Lists</h3>
                {isMyProfile && (
                  <button 
                    className="btn-create-col" 
                    onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}
                    style={{ background: "#9b5cff", color: "#fff", border: "none", padding: "8px 16px", borderRadius: "8px", cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: "600" }}
                  >
                    + New Collection
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {showCreateModal && isMyProfile && (
                <form onSubmit={handleCreateCollection} className="create-col-form" style={{ background: "#111", padding: "20px", borderRadius: "12px", marginBottom: "20px", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)" }}>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    placeholder="Collection Name (e.g. Masterpieces)" 
                    value={newTitle}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)}
                    style={{ width: "100%", padding: "10px", background: "#1a1a20", border: "1px solid #333", color: "#fff", borderRadius: "6px", marginBottom: "10px", outline: "none" }}
                  />
                  <textarea 
                    placeholder="Short description..." 
                    value={newDesc}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewDesc(e.target.value)}
                    style={{ width: "100%", padding: "10px", background: "#1a1a20", border: "1px solid #333", color: "#fff", borderRadius: "6px", marginBottom: "15px", outline: "none", resize: "none", height: "80px" }}
                  />
                  <div className="form-actions" style={{ display: "flex", gap: "10px" }}>
                    <button type="submit" style={{ background: "#1db954", color: "#000", border: "none", padding: "8px 16px", borderRadius: "6px", fontWeight: "bold", cursor: "pointer" }}>Create</button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)} style={{ background: "transparent", color: "#aaa", border: "1px solid #444", padding: "8px 16px", borderRadius: "6px", cursor: "pointer" }}>Cancel</button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              )}

              <div className="collections-grid" style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr))", gap: "20px" }}>
                {collections.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="no-reviews-msg" style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1", textAlign: "center", color: "#888", padding: "40px" }}>No collections found.</p>
                ) : (
                  collections.map(col => (
                    <div 
                      key={col.collection_id} 
                      className="collection-card" 
                      onClick={() => handleCardClick(col.collection_id)}
                      style={{ background: "#111", padding: "20px", borderRadius: "12px", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)", cursor: "pointer", transition: "0.2s" }}
                    >
                      <h4 style={{ margin: "0 0 8px 0", fontSize: "18px", color: "#fff" }}>{col.title}</h4>
                      <p style={{ margin: "0 0 15px 0", color: "#888", fontSize: "14px" }}>{col.description || "No description provided."}</p>
                      <span className="col-count" style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "#9b5cff", fontWeight: "600" }}>🎬 {col.movie_count} Movies</span>
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === "analytics" && (
            <div className="analytics-dashboard">
              <div className="stat-cards-row">
                <div className="stat-card">
                  <h4>Total Watch Time</h4>
                  <h2>{analyticsData.total_hours} <span>hours</span></h2>
                </div>
                <div className="stat-card">
                  <h4>Movies This Year</h4>
                  <h2>{analyticsData.movies_this_year}</h2>
                </div>
                <div className="stat-card">
                  <h4>Average Rating Given</h4>
                  <h2>{analyticsData.avg_rating} ★</h2>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="charts-row">
                <div className="chart-box">
                  <h3>Top Genres</h3>
                  <div className="chart-wrapper">
                    <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={250}>
                      <PieChart>
                        <Pie
                          data={analyticsData.top_genres}
                          innerRadius={60}
                          outerRadius={90}
                          paddingAngle={5}
                          dataKey="value"
                          stroke="none"
                        >
                          {analyticsData.top_genres.map((entry, index) => (
                            <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={COLORS[index % COLORS.length]} />
                          ))}
                        </Pie>
                        <Tooltip contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: "#111", borderColor: "#333", color: "#fff" }} />
                      </PieChart>
                    </ResponsiveContainer>
                  </div>
                  <div className="chart-legend">
                    {analyticsData.top_genres.map((g, i) => (
                      <span key={g.name}><span className="dot" style={{ background: COLORS[i] }}></span> {g.name}</span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="chart-box">
                  <h3>Monthly Watch Activity</h3>
                  <div className="chart-wrapper">
                    <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={250}>
                      <BarChart data={analyticsData.monthly_activity}>
                        <XAxis dataKey="name" stroke="#666" tick={{ fill: '#888' }} />
                        <Tooltip 
                          cursor={{ fill: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' }} 
                          contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: "#111", borderColor: "#333", color: "#fff" }} 
                        />
                        <Bar dataKey="movies" fill="#9b5cff" radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]} />
                      </BarChart>
                    </ResponsiveContainer>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* COLLECTION DETAIL POPUP MODAL */}
      {isColDetailOpen && selectedCollection && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setIsColDetailOpen(false)}>
          <div className="col-modal-content" style={{ maxWidth: "600px", width: "90%" }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h2>{selectedCollection.title}</h2>
            <p style={{ color: "#888", marginBottom: "20px", fontSize: "14px" }}>{selectedCollection.description || "No description provided."}</p>
            
            <div className="col-list-scroll" style={{ maxHeight: "350px", overflowY: "auto" }}>
              {collectionMovies.length === 0 ? (
                <p style={{ color: "#888", textAlign: "center", padding: "30px" }}>No movies added in this collection yet.</p>
              ) : (
                collectionMovies.map(movie => (
                  <Link to={`/movie/${movie.movie_id}`} key={movie.movie_id} className="col-select-item" style={{ textDecoration: "none", color: "#fff", marginBottom: "10px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
                    <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "15px" }}>
                      <img src={movie.poster_url} alt={movie.title} style={{ width: "45px", height: "65px", objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: "6px" }} />
                      <div>
                        <h4 style={{ margin: "0 0 5px 0", fontSize: "16px" }}>{movie.title}</h4>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#aaa" }}>{movie.release_year} • ⭐ {movie.avg_rating || "N/A"}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ color: "#9b5cff", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: "600" }}>View →</span>
                  </Link>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            <button className="close-modal-x" onClick={() => setIsColDetailOpen(false)}>✕</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* EDIT PROFILE MODAL */}
      {showEditModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowEditModal(false)}>
          <div className="col-modal-content" style={{ maxWidth: "400px" }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3>Edit Profile</h3>
            
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveProfile}>
              <label style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#aaa", display: "block", marginBottom: "5px" }}>Username</label>
              <input 
                type="text" 
                value={editUsername} 
                onChange={(e) => setEditUsername(e.target.value)}
                style={{ width: "100%", padding: "12px", background: "#1a1a20", border: "1px solid #444", color: "#fff", borderRadius: "6px", marginBottom: "15px", outline: "none" }}
                autoFocus
              />

              <label style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#aaa", display: "block", marginBottom: "5px" }}>Bio</label>
              <textarea 
                value={editBio} 
                onChange={(e) => setEditBio(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Tell something about yourself..."
                style={{ width: "100%", padding: "12px", background: "#1a1a20", border: "1px solid #444", color: "#fff", borderRadius: "6px", marginBottom: "20px", outline: "none", resize: "none", height: "80px", fontFamily: "inherit" }}
              />
              
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "10px" }}>
                <button type="submit" className="qc-save" style={{ flex: 1, padding: "10px" }}>Save Changes</button>
                <button type="button" className="qc-cancel" onClick={() => setShowEditModal(false)} style={{ flex: 1, padding: "10px" }}>Cancel</button>
              </div>
            </form>

            <button className="close-modal-x" onClick={() => setShowEditModal(false)}>✕</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* FOLLOWERS / FOLLOWING MODAL */}
      {showFollowModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowFollowModal(false)}>
          <div className="col-modal-content" style={{ maxWidth: "400px" }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3 style={{ textTransform: "capitalize", marginBottom: "20px" }}>{followModalType}</h3>
            
            <div style={{ maxHeight: "350px", overflowY: "auto", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "12px" }}>
              {followListData.length === 0 ? (
                <p style={{ color: "#888", textAlign: "center" }}>No {followModalType} found.</p>
              ) : (
                followListData.map((user) => (
                  <Link 
                    to={`/profile/${user.user_id}`} 
                    key={user.user_id} 
                    onClick={() => {
                      setShowFollowModal(false);
                      setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 100);
                    }}
                    style={{ 
                      display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "15px", 
                      padding: "12px", background: "#1a1a20", borderRadius: "10px", 
                      textDecoration: "none", color: "#fff", transition: "0.2s",
                      border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)"
                    }}
                  >
                    <div style={{ width: "42px", height: "42px", borderRadius: "50%", background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #9b5cff, #47b8ff)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", fontWeight: "bold", fontSize: "16px" }}>
                      {user.username.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: "600" }}>@{user.username}</span>
                  </Link>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            <button className="close-modal-x" onClick={() => setShowFollowModal(false)}>✕</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <SearchModal isOpen={isSearchOpen} onClose={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)} />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="Frontend_react/src/styles/navbar.css">
/* 🔥 GOOGLE FONTS FOR NEXUS (Cinzel & Montserrat) */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@700&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400&display=swap');

/* =========================================
   GLOBAL NAVBAR & HEADER
========================================= */
.navbar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 16px 50px;
  background: #0a0a0f;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  width: 100%;
  z-index: 2147483647 !important; /* Max possible z-index */
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* =========================================
   🚀 NEXUS LOGO STYLING
========================================= */
.navbar-logo-container {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.nexus-logo {
  font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; /* Classy Cinematic Font */
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff; /* White color for premium look */
  text-decoration: none;
  letter-spacing: 6px; /* Text ke beech gap premium lagta hai */
  text-shadow: 0px 0px 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); /* Halka sa glow */
}

.nexus-tagline {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 300;
  color: #aaaaaa;
  margin-left: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* =========================================
   🚀 BUTTERY SMOOTH HOVER ANIMATION
========================================= */
.header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

.nav-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0px; 
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: #aaa;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); 
}

.nav-text {
  max-width: 0px;
  opacity: 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.nav-item:hover, .nav-item.active {
  gap: 8px;
  background: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.15);
  border-color: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.3);
  color: #fff;
}

.nav-item:hover .nav-text, .nav-item.active .nav-text {
  max-width: 100px;
  opacity: 1;
}

/* =========================================
   NOTIFICATIONS & DROPDOWNS
========================================= */
.notif-dot {
  position: absolute;
  top: 6px;
  right: 6px;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  background: #ff4757;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid #0a0a0f;
}

.custom-dropdown {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: 50px;
  background: #14141a;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 2147483648 !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.profile-circle {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9b5cff, #47b8ff);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 12px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* =========================================
   👤 PROFILE DROPDOWN FIX
========================================= */
.dropdown-divider {
  height: 1px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  margin: 6px 0;
}

.dropdown-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #ccc;
  text-decoration: none;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition: all 0.2s ease-out;
}

.dropdown-item:hover {
  background: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.1); 
  color: #fff;
}

.dropdown-item.logout-btn {
  color: #ff4757;
}

.dropdown-item.logout-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.1); 
  color: #ff4757;
}

/* =========================================
   ✨ GLASSMORPHISM & CUSTOM SCROLLBAR
========================================= */
.glass-panel {
  background: rgba(15, 15, 20, 0.65) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8) !important;
}

.custom-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 5px;
}
.custom-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.custom-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.custom-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.5); 
}
</file>

<file path="backend/routes/auth.py">
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, g, current_app
from backend.database import engine
from sqlalchemy import text
import bcrypt
import jwt
import random
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from backend.config import JWT_SECRET_KEY
from backend.middleware.auth_middleware import token_required
from flask_mail import Message


# 🔥 DHYAN RAKHNA: Tujhe apni main app file (jaise app.py ya extensions.py) se `mail` object import karna hoga.
# Example: from backend.app import mail
# (Neeche maine ek dummy import likha hai, apne folder structure ke hisaab se theek kar lena)
from backend.extensions import mail

auth_bp = Blueprint("auth", __name__)


# =====================================================================
# 📧 HELPER FUNCTION: EMAIL BHEJNE KE LIYE
# =====================================================================
def send_otp_email(user_email, otp, subject="Your MovieVerse Verification Code"):
    try:
        msg = Message(subject, 
                      sender=current_app.config['MAIL_USERNAME'], 
                      recipients=[user_email])
        msg.body = f"Welcome to MovieVerse! 🎬\n\nYour 6-digit code is: {otp}\n\nPlease don't share this code with anyone."
        mail.send(msg)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print("Mail Error:", e)
        return False


# =====================================================================
# 1️⃣ REGISTER (WITH OTP)
# =====================================================================
@auth_bp.route("/register", methods=["POST"])
def register():
    data = request.get_json()

    username = data.get("username")
    email = data.get("email")
    password = data.get("password")

    if not username or not email or not password:
        return jsonify({"error": "Username, email and password are required"}), 400

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE email = :email"),
            {"email": email}
        ).first()

    if result:
        return jsonify({"error": "Email already registered"}), 409

    password_hash = bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")
    
    # 🔥 NAYA: 6-digit OTP generate karo
    otp = str(random.randint(100000, 999999))

    with engine.begin() as conn:
        # 🔥 NAYA: is_verified aur otp columns add kiye
        result = conn.execute(
            text("""
                INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, is_verified, otp)
                VALUES (:username, :email, :password_hash, 0, :otp)
            """),
            {
                "username": username,
                "email": email,
                "password_hash": password_hash,
                "otp": otp
            }
        )
        user_id = result.lastrowid

    # 🔥 NAYA: OTP Email fire karo!
    email_sent = send_otp_email(email, otp, "Verify your MovieVerse Account")

    if email_sent:
        return jsonify({
            "message": "User registered successfully! Please check your email for the OTP.",
            "user_id": user_id,
            "email": email
        }), 201
    else:
        return jsonify({"error": "User registered, but failed to send email. Please contact support."}), 500


# =====================================================================
# 2️⃣ VERIFY OTP (NEW ROUTE)
# =====================================================================
@auth_bp.route("/verify-otp", methods=["POST"])
def verify_otp():
    data = request.get_json()
    email = data.get("email")
    user_otp = data.get("otp")

    if not email or not user_otp:
        return jsonify({"error": "Email and OTP are required"}), 400

    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            user = conn.execute(
                text("SELECT user_id, otp FROM users WHERE email = :email"), 
                {"email": email}
            ).mappings().first()

            if user and user["otp"] == user_otp:
                # 🟢 OTP Match! Account activate karo aur OTP delete kar do
                conn.execute(text("""
                    UPDATE users SET is_verified = 1, otp = NULL WHERE email = :email
                """), {"email": email})

                conn.execute(text("""
                    INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, message, type) 
                    VALUES (:uid, 'Welcome to MovieVerse! 🎬 Add your first movie to the watchlist.', 'welcome')
                """), {"uid": user["user_id"]})

                return jsonify({"message": "Email verified successfully! You can now login."}), 200
            else:
                return jsonify({"error": "Invalid OTP. Please try again."}), 400
    except Exception as e:
        print("Verify OTP Error:", e)
        return jsonify({"error": "Internal server error"}), 500


# =====================================================================
# 3️⃣ LOGIN (BLOCKED IF NOT VERIFIED)
# =====================================================================
@auth_bp.route("/login", methods=["POST"])
def login():
    data = request.get_json()
    email = data.get("email")
    password = data.get("password")

    if not email or not password:
        return jsonify({"error": "Email and password are required"}), 400

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        user = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT user_id, username, email, password_hash, profile_image, bio, is_verified 
                FROM users WHERE email = :email
            """),
            {"email": email}
        ).mappings().first()

        if user is None:
            return jsonify({"error": "Invalid email or password"}), 401

        # 🔥 NAYA: OTP Verification Check
        if not user["is_verified"]:
            return jsonify({"error": "Please verify your email via OTP before logging in."}), 403

        genre_check = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM user_preference WHERE user_id = :user_id"),
            {"user_id": user["user_id"]}
        ).mappings().first()

        has_genres = genre_check["count"] > 0

    if not bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode("utf-8"), user["password_hash"].encode("utf-8")):
        return jsonify({"error": "Invalid email or password"}), 401

    token = jwt.encode(
        {
            "user_id": user["user_id"],
            "email": user["email"],
            "exp": datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(days=7)
        },
        JWT_SECRET_KEY,
        algorithm="HS256"
    )

    return jsonify({
        "message": "Login successful",
        "token": token,
        "has_genres": has_genres,
        "user": {
            "user_id": user["user_id"],
            "username": user["username"],
            "email": user["email"],
            "profile_image": user["profile_image"],
            "bio": user["bio"]
        }
    }), 200


# =====================================================================
# 4️⃣ FORGOT PASSWORD & RESET (NEW ROUTES)
# =====================================================================
@auth_bp.route("/forgot-password", methods=["POST"])
def forgot_password():
    data = request.get_json()
    email = data.get("email")

    if not email:
        return jsonify({"error": "Email is required"}), 400

    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            user = conn.execute(
                text("SELECT user_id, is_verified FROM users WHERE email = :email"),
                {"email": email}
            ).mappings().first()

            if not user or not user["is_verified"]:
                # Security best practice: Don't reveal if email exists or not to prevent guessing
                return jsonify({"message": "If this email is registered and verified, you will receive an OTP."}), 200
            
            # Generate new OTP for password reset
            otp = str(random.randint(100000, 999999))
            conn.execute(
                text("UPDATE users SET otp = :otp WHERE email = :email"),
                {"otp": otp, "email": email}
            )

        send_otp_email(email, otp, "MovieVerse - Password Reset Code")
        return jsonify({"message": "If this email is registered and verified, you will receive an OTP."}), 200

    except Exception as e:
        print("Forgot Password Error:", e)
        return jsonify({"error": "Internal server error"}), 500


@auth_bp.route("/reset-password-otp", methods=["PUT"])
def reset_password_with_otp():
    data = request.get_json()
    email = data.get("email")
    user_otp = data.get("otp")
    new_password = data.get("new_password")

    if not email or not user_otp or not new_password:
        return jsonify({"error": "Email, OTP, and new password are required"}), 400

    if len(new_password) < 6:
        return jsonify({"error": "Password must be at least 6 characters"}), 400

    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            user = conn.execute(
                text("SELECT user_id, otp FROM users WHERE email = :email"),
                {"email": email}
            ).mappings().first()

            if user and user["otp"] == user_otp:
                # 🟢 OTP Match! Hash new password and clear OTP
                new_password_hash = bcrypt.hashpw(new_password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")
                conn.execute(
                    text("UPDATE users SET password_hash = :hash, otp = NULL WHERE email = :email"),
                    {"hash": new_password_hash, "email": email}
                )

                conn.execute(text("""
                    INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, message, type) 
                    VALUES (:uid, 'Your password was updated successfully. 🔒', 'security')
                """), {"uid": user["user_id"]})

                return jsonify({"message": "Password reset successfully! You can now login."}), 200
            else:
                return jsonify({"error": "Invalid or expired OTP"}), 400

    except Exception as e:
        print("Reset Password Error:", e)
        return jsonify({"error": "Internal server error"}), 500


# =====================================================================
# 5️⃣ CHANGE PASSWORD (LOGGED IN USERS - UNCHANGED)
# =====================================================================
@auth_bp.route("/change-password", methods=["PUT"])
@token_required
def change_password():
    user_id = g.user_id
    data = request.get_json()

    if not data:
        return jsonify({"error": "Request body is required"}), 400

    current_password = data.get("current_password")
    new_password = data.get("new_password")

    if not current_password or not new_password:
        return jsonify({"error": "Current password and new password are required"}), 400

    if len(new_password) < 6:
        return jsonify({"error": "New password must be at least 6 characters"}), 400

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        user = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE user_id = :user_id"),
            {"user_id": user_id}
        ).first()

    if user is None:
        return jsonify({"error": "User not found"}), 404

    if not bcrypt.checkpw(current_password.encode("utf-8"), user.password_hash.encode("utf-8")):
        return jsonify({"error": "Current password is incorrect"}), 401

    new_password_hash = bcrypt.hashpw(new_password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")

    with engine.begin() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            text("UPDATE users SET password_hash = :password_hash WHERE user_id = :user_id"),
            {"password_hash": new_password_hash, "user_id": user_id}
        )

        conn.execute(text("""
            INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, message, type) 
            VALUES (:uid, 'Your password was changed successfully. 🔒', 'security')
        """), {"uid": user_id})

    return jsonify({"message": "Password changed successfully"}), 200

@auth_bp.route("/notifications", methods=["GET"])
@token_required
def get_notifications():
    user_id = g.user_id
    try:
        with engine.connect() as conn:
            # Sirf latest 10 notifications bhejenge
            query = text("""
                SELECT notification_id, sender_id, message, type, is_read, created_at 
                FROM notifications 
                WHERE user_id = :uid 
                ORDER BY created_at DESC 
                LIMIT 10
            """)
            notifs = [dict(row) for row in conn.execute(query, {"uid": user_id}).mappings().all()]
            
            # Unread notifications ka count bhi bhejenge navbar bell icon par red dot ke liye
            unread_count = sum(1 for n in notifs if n['is_read'] == 0)

            return jsonify({"notifications": notifs, "unread_count": unread_count}), 200
    except Exception as e:
        print("Notification Error:", e)
        return jsonify({"error": "Failed to fetch notifications"}), 500

# =====================================================================
# 🔔 MARK NOTIFICATIONS AS READ
# =====================================================================
@auth_bp.route("/notifications/read", methods=["PUT"])
@token_required
def mark_notifications_read():
    user_id = g.user_id
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("""
                UPDATE notifications 
                SET is_read = 1 
                WHERE user_id = :uid AND is_read = 0
            """), {"uid": user_id})
        return jsonify({"message": "Notifications marked as read"}), 200
    except Exception as e:
        print("Mark Read Error:", e)
        return jsonify({"error": "Failed to update notifications"}), 500

# =====================================================================
# 🗑️ DELETE SINGLE NOTIFICATION
# =====================================================================
@auth_bp.route("/notifications/<int:notif_id>", methods=["DELETE"])
@token_required
def delete_notification(notif_id):
    user_id = g.user_id
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            # Sirf log-in user apni hi notification delete kar sake
            conn.execute(
                text("DELETE FROM notifications WHERE notification_id = :nid AND user_id = :uid"),
                {"nid": notif_id, "uid": user_id}
            )
        return jsonify({"message": "Notification deleted"}), 200
    except Exception as e:
        print("Delete Notif Error:", e)
        return jsonify({"error": "Failed to delete notification"}), 500



# =====================================================================
# 👤 TOGGLE FOLLOW USER
# =====================================================================
@auth_bp.route("/users/<int:target_user_id>/follow", methods=["POST"])
@token_required
def toggle_follow(target_user_id):
    user_id = g.user_id 

    if user_id == target_user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "You cannot follow yourself"}), 400

    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            # 🔥 FIX: 'following_id' use kiya hai ab teri table ke hisaab se
            existing_follow = conn.execute(
                text("SELECT * FROM followers WHERE follower_id = :f1 AND following_id = :f2"),
                {"f1": user_id, "f2": target_user_id}
            ).first()

            if existing_follow:
                conn.execute(
                    text("DELETE FROM followers WHERE follower_id = :f1 AND following_id = :f2"),
                    {"f1": user_id, "f2": target_user_id}
                )
                return jsonify({"message": "Unfollowed successfully", "is_following": False}), 200
            else:
                conn.execute(
                    text("INSERT INTO followers (follower_id, following_id) VALUES (:f1, :f2)"),
                    {"f1": user_id, "f2": target_user_id}
                )

                # 🔥 NOTIFICATION TRIGGER
                sender = conn.execute(
                    text("SELECT username FROM users WHERE user_id = :u"), {"u": user_id}
                ).mappings().first()
                
                sender_name = sender["username"] if sender else "Someone"
                
                conn.execute(text("""
                    INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, sender_id, message, type) 
                    VALUES (:target, :sender, :msg, 'follow')
                """), {
                    "target": target_user_id, 
                    "sender": user_id, 
                    "msg": f"@{sender_name} started following you."
                })

                return jsonify({"message": "Followed successfully", "is_following": True}), 200

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FOLLOW ERROR: {e}")
        return jsonify({"error": "Failed to follow user"}), 500

import jwt
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, g, current_app
from sqlalchemy import text

from backend.services.search import search_movies
from backend.database import engine
from backend.middleware.auth_middleware import token_required


search_bp = Blueprint("search", __name__)

@search_bp.route("/search", methods=["GET"])
def search():
    query = request.args.get("q", "").strip()
    search_type = request.args.get("type", "movie")
    
    current_user_id = None
    auth_header = request.headers.get("Authorization")
    if auth_header and auth_header.startswith("Bearer "):
        try:
            token = auth_header.split(" ")[1]
            payload = jwt.decode(token, current_app.config.get("SECRET_KEY", "your_secret_key"), algorithms=["HS256"])
            current_user_id = payload.get("user_id") or payload.get("id")
        except Exception:
            pass

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        if search_type == "user":
            if current_user_id:
                users_query = text("""
                    SELECT user_id, username 
                    FROM users 
                    WHERE username LIKE :q AND user_id != :current_id 
                    LIMIT 12
                """)
                results = [dict(row) for row in conn.execute(users_query, {"q": f"%{query}%", "current_id": current_user_id}).mappings().all()]
            else:
                users_query = text("""
                    SELECT user_id, username 
                    FROM users 
                    WHERE username LIKE :q 
                    LIMIT 12
                """)
                results = [dict(row) for row in conn.execute(users_query, {"q": f"%{query}%"}).mappings().all()]
            
            return jsonify(results), 200

        elif search_type == "actor":
            search_pattern = f"%{query}%"
            actors_query = text("""
                SELECT MIN(actor_id) as actor_id, actor_name 
                FROM actors 
                WHERE actor_name LIKE :q 
                GROUP BY actor_name
                LIMIT 12
            """)
            results = [dict(row) for row in conn.execute(actors_query, {"q": search_pattern}).mappings().all()]
            return jsonify(results), 200

        else:
            # Movie search logic
            movies_query = text("""
                SELECT movie_id, title, release_year, avg_rating, poster_url 
                FROM movies 
                WHERE title LIKE :q 
                LIMIT 12
            """)
            results = [dict(row) for row in conn.execute(movies_query, {"q": f"%{query}%"}).mappings().all()]
            return jsonify(results), 200

    
@search_bp.route("/search/history", methods=["GET"])
@token_required
def search_history():
    user_id = g.user_id

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        history = conn.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT
                    history_id,
                    search_query,
                    searched_at
                FROM search_history
                WHERE user_id = :user_id
                ORDER BY searched_at DESC
            """),
            {
                "user_id": user_id
            }
        ).mappings().all()

    history_list = [dict(item) for item in history]

    return jsonify({
        "total_searches": len(history_list),
        "history": history_list
    }), 200


@search_bp.route("/search/history/<int:history_id>", methods=["DELETE"])
@token_required
def delete_search_history(history_id):
    user_id = g.user_id

    with engine.begin() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(
            text("""
                DELETE FROM search_history
                WHERE history_id = :history_id
                AND user_id = :user_id
            """),
            {
                "history_id": history_id,
                "user_id": user_id
            }
        )

    if result.rowcount == 0:
        return jsonify({
            "error": "Search history not found"
        }), 404

    return jsonify({
        "message": "Search history deleted successfully",
        "history_id": history_id
    }), 200


@search_bp.route("/search/history", methods=["DELETE"])
@token_required
def clear_search_history():
    user_id = g.user_id

    with engine.begin() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(
            text("""
                DELETE FROM search_history
                WHERE user_id = :user_id
            """),
            {
                "user_id": user_id
            }
        )

    return jsonify({
        "message": "Search history cleared successfully",
        "deleted_count": result.rowcount
    }), 200
